name: Ice Nova
desc: Conjure a wave of ice in all directions, Knocking Back enemies based on how close they are to you. Casting Ice Nova targeting near a Frostbolt Projectile will cause it to originate from the Frostbolt instead of you. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to leave a patch of Chilled Ground.

name: Leap Slam
weapon: One Hand Mace, Two Hand Mace
desc: Jump into the air, damaging and Knocking Back enemies with your mace where you land. Enemies you would land on are\npushed out of the way.
nText: Damage +% final vs fully broken armour +20%

name: Molten Crash
tags: Shapeshift, Bear, AoE, Melee, Slam, Travel
desc: Shapeshift into a burning monstrosity and leap through the air to crash down upon the earth, Slamming twice and creating Molten Fissures. Consumes Rage to create additional Molten Fissures.

name: Shield Charge
desc: Channel to charge in the target direction. You will crash into enemies on your path, stopping your charge and dealing damage to enemies in an area, and extra damage to the enemies you collided with. While charging, your Shield is raised and you will Block all incoming Blockable hits.

name: Detonate Dead
desc: Cause a Corpse to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.

name: Volatile Dead
desc: Consume a Corpse to create a volatile core that seeks out enemies and Ignites enemies near it. The core explodes at the end of its duration.

name: Fire Attunement
desc: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Fire Damage but deal less Cold and Lightning Damage.

name: Rapid Attacks I
desc: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.

name: Rapid Attacks II
desc: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.

name: Rapid Attacks III
desc: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster at the cost of Damage.

name: Multishot I
desc: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.

name: Multishot II
desc: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.

name: Nova Projectiles I
desc: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire Projectiles in a circle. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above.

name: Projectile Acceleration I
desc: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster.

name: Projectile Acceleration II
desc: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and granting them a chance to Pierce Enemies.

name: Projectile Acceleration III
desc: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and causing increases and reductions to Projectile speed to also apply to Damage.

name: Cold Attunement
desc: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Cold Damage but deal less Fire and Lightning Damage.

name: Heightened Accuracy I
desc: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy.

name: Heightened Accuracy II
desc: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy, and never miss against Enemies on full Life.

name: Magnified Area I
desc: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.

name: Magnified Area II
desc: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.

name: Lightning Attunement
desc: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Lightning Damage but deal less Cold and Fire Damage.

name: Raise Zombie
desc: Consume a Corpse or Power Charge to create a short-lived Zombie. Zombies created from Power Charges are Empowered and also create two additional non-empowered Zombies.

name: Efficiency I
desc: Supports any skill, making it cost less to use. Cannot support skills which reserve Spirit.

name: Efficiency II
desc: Supports any skill, making it cost less to use. Cannot support skills which reserve Spirit.

name: Supercritical
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage with Critical Hits but have less Critical Hit chance.

name: Knockback
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Knock Back enemies.

name: Life Leech I
desc: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.

name: Life Leech II
desc: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.

name: Life Leech III
desc: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life and preventing Leech gained this way from being removed at full Life.

name: Mana Leech
desc: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Mana.

name: Oisin's Oath
desc: Supports Skills which Hit enemies, causing their Mana Leech to recover based on Elemental damage instead of Physical damage.

name: Chaos Attunement
desc: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Chaos Damage but deal less Damage of other Types.

name: Flicker Strike
desc: Teleport to a enemy and Strike them. Consumes Power Charges to perform additional teleporting Strikes on nearby enemies.

name: Spark
desc: Launch a spray of sparking Projectiles that travel erratically along the ground until they hit an enemy or expire. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to fire many sparks in a circle.

name: Pierce I
desc: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy but deal less damage after doing so.

name: Pierce II
desc: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy.

name: Pierce III
desc: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an unlimited number of enemies, losing damage as they do so.

name: Spectre: {0}
desc: Summon the spirit of the bound monster as a Reviving Minion.

name: Frost Wall
desc: Create a wall of Ice Crystals which holds back enemies. The Crystals explode if sufficiently damaged, or if pushed hard enough, damaging nearby enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to add another Lightning explosion if destroyed.

name: Enervating Nova
desc: Unleash a Nova of Lightning damage to Electrocute enemies. Enemies close to you take no damage while enemies at the edge of the ring take significantly more damage. Enemies Hit can be Electrocuted by all Lightning damage for a short duration.

name: Heavy Swing
desc: Supports Melee Attacks, boosting their Physical damage at the cost of Attack Speed.

name: Rapid Casting I
desc: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.

name: Rapid Casting II
desc: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.

name: Rapid Casting III
desc: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster for each different Spell you've cast in the last eight seconds.

name: Temporal Chains
desc: Curse all enemies in an area, Slowing them and making other effects on them expire more slowly.

name: Enfeeble
desc: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, making them deal less damage.

name: Sniper's Mark
desc: Mark a target. The next Critical Hit the target receives Activates the Mark, Consuming it to deal extra damage and grant you a Frenzy Charge.
nText: Enemy additional critical strike multiplier against self 15

name: Despair
desc: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Chaos Resistance.

name: Lightning Warp
desc: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. Can also be used on Ball Lightning Projectiles. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Lightning damage to surrounding enemies. If targeting an enemy, the explosion also creates Shocked Ground. Creates a Lightning Infusion on successful use. Highlights enemies that can be Culled.

name: His Vile Intrusion
desc: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Physical damage to surrounding enemies and inflicts Impale.

name: Armour Breaker
weapon: One Hand Mace, Two Hand Mace
desc: Strike with a forceful blow, knocking enemies back and weakening their Armour.

name: Rain of Arrows
desc: Fire a hail of arrows into the air, causing them to rain from above. Consumes a Frenzy Charge to fire more arrows.

name: Concentrated Area
desc: Supports any skill with an area of effect, causing that area to be smaller but any area damage it deals to be higher.

name: Bloodlust
desc: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to deal more damage against Bleeding enemies, but preventing them from inflicting Bleeding.

name: Firestorm
tags: AoE, Sustained, Fire, Duration, Repeatable, Storm
desc: Rain a storm of flaming bolts over the targeted area. Can Consume all three types of Elemental Infusion, creating a much larger storm when Fire-Infused, causing lightning bolts when Lightning-Infused, and raining ice bolts when Cold-Infused.

name: Falling Thunder
desc: Suffuse your Quarterstaff with electrical energy, then Slam the ground to deal damage in a large cone in front of you. Consumes your Power Charges to fire Lightning Projectiles forwards from the impact.
nText: Lightning strike damage +% final per power charge +20%

name: Power Siphon
desc: Attempt to rip the lifeforce from an enemy. Enemies within Culling range will be highlighted and instantly killed on Hit, granting a Power Charge. Can only target Enemies in Culling range.

name: Lightning Arrow
desc: Fire a charged arrow at the target. On hitting an enemy or wall, the arrow will fire Chaining Lightning beams at nearby enemies.

name: Discipline
desc: Emit an Aura that grants you and Allies in your Presence additional Total Energy Shield.
nText: Buff energy shield recharge rate +% to apply +20%

name: Shockwave Totem
tags: Totem, AoE, Melee, Slam, Duration, Nova
desc: Raise a Totem that Slams the ground around it, repeatedly damaging nearby enemies. Jagged Ground erupts when hit by this Slam, damaging enemies standing on it. The Totem cannot create Jagged Ground. This Skill can be used while Shapeshifted.

name: Blind I
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit.

name: Blind II
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit with increased effect.

name: Valako's Charge
desc: While active, taking Lightning damage builds up charge on you. Reaching full charge expends all charge to Trigger this skill, creating a Chaining lightning bolt that arcs to nearby enemies.

name: Arc
desc: An arc of Lightning stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and Chains on to other nearby enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to deal more damage and Chain further.

name: Arctic Armour
desc: While active, conjures an icy barrier that gains stages over time. While the barrier has stages, Melee Attacks that hit you will remove a stage to cause a burst of ice that deals Cold Spell damage to the attacker.
nText: Maximum number of arctic armour stationary stacks 1

name: Fire Penetration I
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Fire resistance.

name: Fire Penetration II
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits ignore enemy Fire resistance.

name: Cold Penetration
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Cold resistance.

name: Lightning Penetration
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Lightning resistance.

name: Chain I
desc: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

name: Chain II
desc: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

name: Chain III
desc: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

name: Fork
desc: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Fork.

name: Elemental Weakness
tags: AoE, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration, Curse, Repeatable
desc: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Elemental Resistances.

name: Incinerate
desc: Gain fuel by spending Mana on any Skill, then use the accumulated fuel to conjure a torrent of Fire from your hand, Igniting enemies in front of you. The flames grow stronger the longer you Channel. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to also create Ignited Ground. Cannot gain fuel while using this skill.

name: Spell Echo
desc: Supports Cascadable Spells you use yourself. Supported Spells Echo.

name: Elemental Army
desc: Supports skills which create Minions, bolstering the Elemental Resistances of those Minions. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

name: Projectile Deceleration I
desc: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.

name: Projectile Deceleration II
desc: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.

name: Vilenta's Propulsion
desc: Supports Spell Skills that fire Projectiles, causing increases and reductions to cast speed to also apply to Projectile speed.

name: Purity of Fire
desc: Emit an Aura that boosts the Fire Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
nText: Buff fire damage resistance % to apply +8%

name: Purity of Ice
desc: Emit an Aura that boosts the Cold Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
nText: Buff cold damage resistance % to apply +8%

name: Purity of Lightning
desc: Emit an Aura that boosts the Lightning Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
nText: Buff lightning damage resistance % to apply +8%

name: Impurity
desc: Emit an Aura that boosts the Chaos Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
nText: Buff chaos damage resistance % to apply +6%

name: Flameblast
desc: Channel to build destructive energy around you. Releasing the energy causes a devastating explosion that is larger and more intense the longer you Channelled for.

name: Barrage
desc: Ready a volley of arrows or spears, Empowering your next Repeatable Bow or Projectile Spear Attack to Repeat multiple times. Consumes your Frenzy Charges on use to add additional repeats.
nText: Empower barrage damage -% final with repeated projectiles -5

name: Ball Lightning
tags: AoE, Projectile, Sustained, Lightning, Duration, Chaining, Repeatable
desc: Fire a slow-moving Projectile that moves through enemies. The Projectile itself does not Hit enemies, but repeatedly discharges bolts of Lightning at nearby enemies. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to slow down over time, create Ignited Ground as it travels, and explode dealing Fire damage in an Area after it dissipates.

name: Bone Offering
desc: Impale a Skeleton on a bone spike to shield your Minions while the spike remains, reducing the amount of damage taken from Hits. Taking a Hit that deals damage above a certain threshold will cause that Minion's shield to absorb all damage from that Hit, then explode.  The bone spike is itself a Minion, and shields itself. If it dies, shields on your other Minions disappear.
nText: Bone offering damage taken +% final after shield loss -30%

name: Herald of Ash
desc: While active, enemies you sufficiently Overkill with non-Herald Attacks will cause an explosion that Ignites nearby enemies based on the Overkill damage dealt.
nText: Herald of ash burning % overkill damage per minute 300

name: Herald of Ice
tags: Attack, Persistent, AoE, Cold, Herald, Payoff
desc: While active, Shattering an enemy with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause an icy explosion that deals Attack damage to surrounding enemies.

name: Herald of Thunder
tags: Attack, Persistent, AoE, Lightning, Herald, Payoff
desc: While active, killing Shocked enemies with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause subsequent Attack Hits to release lightning bolts which deals Attack damage to all surrounding enemies.
nText: Herald of thunder storm max hits 2

name: Blasphemy
desc: Turn socketed Curse skills into vile Auras, applying their effects to all nearby enemies.

name: Infernal Cry
desc: Perform a Warcry, Empowering subsequent Melee Attacks if there are enemies nearby. Enemies in the warcry's area are destabilised and will Combust on death. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
nText: Infernal cry exerted attack all damage % to gain as fire +10%

name: Ice Bite I
desc: Supports damaging skills and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with supported skills infuses your damage with Cold damage for a short time.

name: Ice Bite II
desc: Supports damaging skills and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with supported skills infuses your damage with Cold damage for a short time.

name: Bhatair's Vengeance
desc: Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with Supported Skills infuses you and your allies with Cold damage for a short time.

name: Freeze
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more effective at Freezing enemies.

name: Shock
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Shock.

name: Shattering Spite
desc: Stamp your spear, destroying all Bloodstone Lances on each enemy in your Presence to cause a damaging explosion around that enemy. Each explosion gains new benefits when reaching higher thresholds of Bloodstone Lances removed from an enemy, causing them to deal more damage, have increased area of effect, and Leech Life from enemies caught in the blast.

name: Righteous Descent
tags: AoE, Melee, Slam, Physical, Lightning, Travel
desc: Leap into the air carried by divine wings, damaging enemies with your spear where you land. If there is a Fragment of Divinity near you or the targeted location, this attack will Consume it when you leap to become Empowered, dealing more damage and granting life and mana recovery. This skill does not use up its Cooldown when empowered.

name: Rolling Magma
tags: Shapeshift, Wyvern, AoE, Projectile, Fire, Detonator
desc: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and lob a ball of magma that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skill Chains, bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times. Impacts on Molten Fissures or Volcanos will activate them as though they were Slammed.

name: Frost Bomb
desc: Create a pulsing Orb of frost. Each pulse inflicts Elemental Exposure on nearby enemies. When the Orb's duration ends, it Detonates, dealing Cold damage to surrounding enemies and leaving behind a Cold Infusion.
nText: All elemental exposure compounding magnitude cap 10

name: Orb of Storms
tags: AoE, Sustained, Lightning, Duration, Chaining, Orb, Remnant, Repeatable
desc: Create an Orb of electricity that fires Chaining Lightning bolts at nearby enemies. The Orb leaves behind a Lightning Infusion Remnant when it expires.

name: Earthquake
weapon: One Hand Mace, Two Hand Mace
desc: Smash the ground, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind Jagged Ground that slows enemies. The Jagged Ground erupts in a powerful Aftershock after a duration. Cannot create Jagged Ground on top of an existing patch, or if you already have the maximum number of active patches.

name: Contagion
desc: Afflict a single enemy with a Debuff that deals Chaos damage over time. If the enemy dies while affected by Contagion, it spreads itself, Curses, and other Chaos damage over time Debuffs on the target to nearby enemies. This refreshes their durations. Reanimating or detonating a corpse affected by Contagion will cause the Minion or explosion to spread Contagion on hit.

name: Wither
desc: Channel a debilitating hex that Withers enemies in the area.

name: Essence Drain
desc: Fire a Projectile that applies a powerful Chaos damage over time debuff to enemies it hits.

name: Controlled Destruction
desc: Supports Spells that Hit enemies, boosting their damage but preventing them from dealing Critical Hits.

name: Sunder
weapon: One Hand Mace, Two Hand Mace
desc: Slam the ground, creating a roiling fissure that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies. Hitting an enemy with Fully Broken Armour applies Sundered Armour, making it take additional increased Physical damage.

name: Frostbolt
desc: Fire a slow-moving Piercing Projectile that is effective at Chilling enemies and explodes on colliding with terrain.
nText: Projectile damage +% final if pierced enemy +20%

name: Elemental Focus
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Elemental Damage but be unable to inflict Elemental Ailments.

name: Skeletal Sniper
desc: Activate to summon long-ranged, Reviving Skeletal Snipers that can fire a gas arrow on Command.

name: Skeletal Reaver
desc: Activate to summon aggressive, Reviving Skeletal Reavers that can enrage on Command. Skeletal Reavers do more Attack Damage and gain increased Attack speed based on their Rage

name: Skeletal Brute
desc: Activate to summon hard-hitting, Reviving Skeletal Brutes that can Stun Primed enemies and Warcry on Command. This Warcry Intimidates nearby enemies and Consumes Freeze on enemies and allies to deal damage in an Area around them.

name: Skeletal Frost Mage
desc: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Frost Mages that can envelop your Minions in an icy shield on Command.

name: Skeletal Storm Mage
desc: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Storm Mages that can call down a lightning strike on dead Skeletons on Command.
nText: Minion maximum life % to gain as maximum energy shield 20

name: Skeletal Arsonist
desc: Activate to summon bomb-throwing, Reviving Skeletal Arsonists that can detonate other Minions on Command.

name: Skeletal Cleric
desc: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Clerics that heal other minions and revive fallen Skeletons.
nText: Skeletal cleric revived skeletons immune for X 3000ms

name: Azmerian Wolf
desc: Summons an ancient Reviving Azmerian Wolf that can howl, calling to spirits convening an Eternal Hunt on Command. It Maims when attacking foes, and can lunge to bite and inflict Bleeding, or howl to inspire nearby allies.

name: Mist Raven
desc: Summons a mysterious undamageable Mist Raven that can be Commanded to dive at target location, crashing through an otherworldly mirror and damaging enemies in an area. The raven grants you a Frenzy Charge for each enemy it Culls.
nText: Chance to gain 1 more frenzy charge +20%

name: Spiraling Conspiracy
desc: A flock of mist ravens circle you, dealing damage over time in an area. Their numbers are bolstered by slain foes, or in the Presence of dangerous enemies, but the flock as a whole is considered a single minion. You can Command some of them to take flight, leaving the flock to assail your enemies.

name: Wildfire
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, Spreading Ignites it inflicts to nearby enemies after a delay.

name: Bleed I
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.

name: Bleed II
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.

name: Bleed III
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Bleeding.

name: Bleed IV
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Melee Physical Damage to Bleeding Enemies, but be unable to inflict Bleeding itself. Supported Skills also inflict Incision on Hit.

name: Poison I
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.

name: Poison II
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.

name: Poison III
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies and causing it to inflict more powerful Poisons against Bleeding Enemies.

name: Maim
desc: Supports Attacks, causing them to Maim enemies.

name: Immolate
desc: Supports Attacks, granting them extra Fire damage against Ignited enemies but making them unable to Ignite enemies themselves.

name: Lasting Shock
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies or inflicts Shock, causing its Shocks to be inflicted less often but last longer.

name: Brutality I
desc: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.

name: Brutality II
desc: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.

name: Brutality III
desc: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types, as well as giving Hits from that skill a chance to ignore Physical Damage reduction.

name: Momentum
desc: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal more damage if you move a sufficient distance while using the skill. Teleportation does not count towards the distance travelled.

name: Arcane Surge
desc: Supports Spells you cast yourself, tracking the mana you spend to cast them. Spending enough mana grants a burst of Mana Regeneration and Cast Speed.

name: Vulnerability
desc: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay. making Hits against them ignore a portion of their Armour.

name: Withering Touch
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Wither enemies on Hit.

name: Soulrend
desc: Fire a Piercing Projectile that seeks out enemies. Enemies hit are inflicted with a Debuff that Hinders them and deals Chaos damage over time for a short duration.

name: Expand
desc: Supports Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when cast, increasing area of effect. Cannot support Channelling Skills or Skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

name: Unleash
desc: Supports Repeatable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when cast, each causing the Spell to Repeat. Cannot support skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

name: Zarokh's Revolt
desc: Supports Repeatable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time and giving them a moderate Cooldown. The Seals are broken when cast, each causing the Spell to Repeat. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown or gain seals.

name: Close Combat I
desc: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.

name: Close Combat II
desc: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.

name: Rage I
desc: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.

name: Rage II
desc: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.

name: Rage III
desc: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit. Supported Skills have signficantly higher Attack speed while you or supported minion are not at maximum Rage.

name: Plague Bearer
desc: While active, stores a portion of the Poison Damage you deal. Using this Skill unleashes the stored Poison to damage and Poison enemies around you.
nText: Plague bearer gains % of damage from inflicted poisons 2

name: Feeding Frenzy I
desc: Supports skills which create Minions, making them deal and take more damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

name: Meat Shield I
desc: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

name: Meat Shield II
desc: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage.

name: Brutus' Brain
desc: Supports skills which create Minions, causing those Minions to be unable to deal or take Damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

name: Infernal Legion I
desc: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

name: Infernal Legion II
desc: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

name: Infernal Legion III
desc: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

name: Siege Ballista
tags: Totem, AoE, Projectile, Sustained, Fire, Duration, Repeatable
desc: Deploy a Ballista Totem that fires bolts skyward, to explode a short time after landing.

name: Second Wind I
desc: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

name: Second Wind II
desc: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

name: Second Wind III
desc: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown and causing them to recover your Life when a Skill is used and goes on cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

name: Seismic Cry
desc: Perform a damaging Warcry, Knocking Back nearby enemies and Heavy Stunning enemies that are Primed for Stun. If an enemy is Heavy Stunned or a currently Heavy Stunned enemy is Hit, this Skill Empowers subsequent Slams to perform an additional Aftershock. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
nText: Seismic cry slam skill aftershock damage +10%

name: Earthshatter
weapon: One Hand Mace, Two Hand Mace
desc: Slam the ground, sending out a fissure that deals area damage to enemies it passes under and thrusts a spike from the ground when it ends. Warcries performed near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies.

name: Sigil of Power
desc: Place a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful Spell Damage Buff to you and Allies while standing in it. The Buff becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.

name: Rite of Restoration
desc: Place a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful Buff to you and Allies standing in it which grants Life Regeneration and amplifies Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield. The Buff becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.

name: Flame Wall
desc: Create a wall of Fire in front of you, which Ignites everything within its area. Any Projectiles fired through the wall by you and Allies deal added Fire damage. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to also add Lightning damage to the Projectiles.

name: Impending Doom
desc: Supports Curse skills you cast yourself, causing them to trigger Doom Blast on Cursed enemies when the Curse expires.

name: Hexblast
desc: Detonate a Curse on every enemy in an area, causing explosions of Chaos damage but removing the Curse. Can only detonate Curses for which at least half of the duration has expired.
nText: Hexblast damage +% final per second remaining curse duration +10%

name: Exsanguinate
desc: Expel your own blood as Chaining blood tendrils in a cone in front of you. Enemies Hit by the tendrils take Physical damage and are inflicted with Bleeding.

name: Reap
desc: Conjure a bloody scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing Physical damage to enemies and applying Critical Weakness. Cannot be Triggered.

name: Lifetap
desc: Supports any Skill, turning its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit.

name: Atalui's Bloodletting
desc: Supports any Skill, turning a portion of its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit. Supported Skills Gain a portion of their Life cost as extra Physical Damage.

name: Behead I
desc: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill.

name: Behead II
desc: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal two Modifiers from Rare monsters they kill.

name: Einhar's Beastrite
desc: Supports Melee Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill for a lengthy duration, while being unable to damage enemies not on low Life. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

name: Execute I
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.

name: Execute II
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.

name: Execute III
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life, as well as dealing more damage while you are on Low Life.

name: Boneshatter
weapon: One Hand Mace, Two Hand Mace
desc: Attack enemies with a melee Strike. The Strike will cause a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. Upon causing a Heavy Stun it will also create a Shockwave, dealing a large amount of damage in an area.

name: Eye of Winter
desc: Fire a single Eye Projectile which does not Hit enemies. The Eye constantly releases damaging shard Projectiles in a spiral as it flies. If the Eye passes over an Elemental Ground Surface or Orb, it will take on that surface's effect causing shards to deal more damage of the corresponding Type.

name: Tornado
desc: Create a storm that sucks in enemies and deals Physical damage over time. A Tornado that overlaps an Elemental Ground Surface absorbs that surface's Debuff, applying it to enemies inside the Tornado and causing the Tornado to deal extra damage of that element.

name: Overcharge
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making its Shocks more effective but reflecting them back to you as well.

name: Lightning Conduit
desc: Call down Lightning to hit all enemies in a cone in front of you, dealing significantly more damage to Shocked enemies. If there is a Shocked enemy in the target area, additional lightning bolts are distributed among the targets hit. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.

name: Galvanic Field
tags: Spell, AoE, Sustained, Lightning, Duration, Chaining, Orb
desc: Gain a Buff that boosts your Shock chance. Shocking an enemy consumes the Buff to attach an Orb of electricity to that enemy. The Orb fires bolts of electricity at nearby enemies until it expires.

name: Volcanic Fissure
tags: AoE, Melee, Slam, Sustained, Fire, Duration
weapon: One Hand Mace, Two Hand Mace
desc: Slam the ground, creating a branching Molten Fissure that deals damage as it travels and remains for a duration. Using a different Slam on a Molten Fissure creates a spreading Aftershock.

name: Rapid Assault
desc: Perform a series of six rapid stabs. The final stab inflicts Bleeding and leaves a spearhead stuck in the target, Maiming them for a duration. Detonator Skills will cause the stuck spearheads to explode, dealing further damage to the target and other nearby enemies.
nText: Rapid assault % chance to attach additional spear 20

name: Disengage
desc: Jump back as you rupture the earth in front of you with spearpoints, damaging enemies. Consumes the Parried Debuff on Hitting enemies to release a shockwave and grant you a Frenzy Charge. This skill can be used while using other skills, and causes Strikes and Projectiles to miss you while jumping. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.

name: Blood Hunt
desc: Lunge at a target and skewers them. Hitting an enemy that has suffered Blood Loss will cause a blood explosion and also Consume Bleeding. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.

name: Whirling Slash
desc: Perform a circular slash that kicks up a Whirlwind around you, Slowing enemies and Blinding them in its area of effect. Leaving the area collapses the storm, dealing damage and causing Knockback.
nText: Sandstorm swipe storm damage +% final per stage +40%

name: Spearfield
desc: Stab the ground causing multiple spears to burst out of the ground in front of you in a large area. The spears remain for a duration, or explode when enemies touch them, damaging and Maiming them.

name: Lightning Spear
desc: Throw a single copy of your spear. When it hits an enemy it bursts, firing secondary lightning bolt Projectiles at multiple other enemies within a large area around it. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to cause the main spear to split into multiple copies on impact, each of which then bursts.

name: Glacial Lance
desc: Throw a single Piercing lance that leaves icy fragments in its wake. The fragments Chill nearby enemies. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to cause the glacial fragments created by the first Projectile to explode outwards after a short duration, peppering enemies with shrapnel.

name: Whirling Assault
desc: Advance while hitting enemies around you with a series of spinning Strikes.

name: Rolling Slam
weapon: One Hand Mace, Two Hand Mace
desc: Slam the ground to Stun enemies and knock them away, then continue forward and perform a devastating second Slam.

name: Escape Shot
desc: Leap backwards, firing an icy arrow which can Chill or Freeze enemies around the location from which you escaped. This arrow will create Ice Fragments on impact.

name: Supercharged Slam
desc: Channel to charge up a heavy swing, drawing earth from the ground to enlarge your mace. Release to Slam the ground, dealing damage in an area around the impact, followed by Aftershocks dealing damage in a larger area. This Skill has its own Attack time, which is not affected by your weapon's attack speed and cannot be modified.

name: Wind Blast
desc: Batter enemies at range by generating a gust of wind as you swing. Enemies will be Dazed and Knocked Back based on how close they are to you.
nText: Wind blast damage +% final from distance +20%

name: Wave of Frost
desc: Flip backwards and send forth a Freezing wave in front of you, immediately Freezing enemies which are Primed for Freeze.

name: Ice Strike
desc: Perform a fast icy Strike. Using this Attack three times in quick succession causes a final strike that is slower and more powerful.

name: Jagged Ground I
desc: Supports Slam skills. Supported Skills will consume Endurance Charges on use to create Jagged Ground.

name: Jagged Ground II
desc: Supports Slam skills. Aftershocks caused by Supported Slam Skills always create patches of Jagged Ground.

name: Inexorable Critical I
desc: Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time.

name: Inexorable Critical II
desc: Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time, but also reduce your Critical Damage Bonus.

name: Ruthless
desc: Supports Attacks, causing repeated uses to be more effective at Stunning enemies.

name: Compressed Duration I
desc: Supports any skill that has a duration making that duration shorter.

name: Compressed Duration II
desc: Supports any skill that has a duration making that duration shorter.

name: Fist of War I
desc: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.

name: Fist of War II
desc: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.

name: Fist of War III
desc: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a very powerful Ancestral Boost infrequently.

name: Prolonged Duration I
desc: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration longer.

name: Prolonged Duration II
desc: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration longer.

name: Impact Shockwave
desc: Supports Melee Strike Skills and Wind Attack Skills, causing them to create an Aftershock that damages enemies around the target when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

name: Hex Bloom
desc: Supports Curses, spreading their effects when a Cursed enemy dies.

name: Glacial Cascade
desc: Sweep your Quarterstaff upwards, releasing an icy fissure which deals damage in a series of bursts culminating in a large spike. Frozen enemies hit by the final spike are dealt heavy damage but the Freeze is Consumed. Ice Crystals hit by the final spike explode.
nText: Physical damage % to gain as cold 15

name: Comet
desc: Call down a mass of ice from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to cause a devastating blast of ice and fire.

name: Consecrate
desc: Create an area of Consecrated Ground around you.

name: Artillery Ballista
desc: Deploy a Ballista Totem that rains down a salvo of Pinning, Maiming bolts.

name: Mana Tempest
desc: Create a storm of arcane energies that Empowers your Mana-costing Spells while you remain inside it. Maintaining the storm constantly drains your Mana, and spending more causes it to drain faster. The storm will dissipate when you exit it or run out of Mana.

name: Killing Palm
desc: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, Culling enemies if their life is low enough and performing additional dashing Strikes to other Cullable targets in range if your target was Culled. Each enemy killed by this strike grants a Power Charge, with higher Rarity monsters granting additional Charges. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.

name: Crushing Fear
desc: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, Culling enemies if their life is low enough. When this skill kills an enemy you draw out their final fears, crushing them to create a shockwave. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.

name: Shattering Palm
desc: Dash to an enemy and Strike them with an Attack that manifests a wave of cold, coating nearby enemies in shards of ice. Dealing enough damage to these enemies will shatter the shards, causing an icy explosion that deals Attack damage.

name: Volcano
tags: AoE, Projectile, Sustained, Fire, Duration, Channelling
desc: Uplift a volcano from the earth, damaging enemies standing on it and releasing a spray of molten Projectiles. While the volcano persists, Slamming it will cause another Projectile spray. Channelling this Skill for longer makes the initial eruption more violent, but does not affect subsequent Projectile sprays.

name: Wolf Pack
desc: Activate to summon a pack of Wolf Companions. The pack treated as a single Companion for effects that count or limit Companions, regardless of the number of Wolves in the pack.

name: Cackling Companions
desc: Activate to summon a cackle of Hyena Companions. The cackle is treated as a single Companion for effects that count or limit Companions, regardless of the number of Hyenas in the cackle. Hyenas whoop when they first appear, Hindering nearby enemies, and have a chance to Maim enemies they Hit.

name: Frost Nexus
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to create patches of Chilled Ground around Frozen enemies.

name: Spiral Volley
desc: Load your Bow with a volley of enchanted arrows and fire them in a circle as you spin forward, firing directly at targets if possible. Consumes Frenzy Charges to cause the arrows to deal more damage and Chain to other targets. Each target can only be Hit once.

name: Maul
desc: Shapeshift into a Bear and rake enemies with your claws, generating Rage on Hit.
nText: Gain x rage on attack hit 2

name: Rend
tags: Shapeshift, Wyvern, AoE, Melee, Strike, Duration
desc: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and perform a wide slash with your wingtip claws. Consumes a Power Charge if possible to grant you a Buff that gives you extra Lightning damage. While you have the Buff, Rend covers a much larger area but is slower.
nText: Wyvern devour base all damage % to gain as lightning 10

name: Pounce
tags: Minion, Shapeshift, Werewolf, AoE, Melee, Slam, Trigger, Mark, Duration, Travel, Meta
desc: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and leap to a target location, damaging enemies in an area around where you land. Predator's Mark will be Triggered targeting the highest Rarity enemy Hit, or if a Mark gem is socketed into this Skill, that Mark will be Triggered instead. Using this Skill allows any Wolf Minions you have to leap immediately.

name: Lightning Bolt
desc: Call down a Shocking bolt of Lightning to strike enemies in a small area.

name: Rampage
tags: Shapeshift, Bear, AoE, Melee, Slam, Sustained, Channelling, Travel
desc: Shapeshift into a Bear and charge forward, Slamming the ground as you run. Channelling ends after a short amount of time but can be prolonged by spending Rage.
nText: Channelled skill suppress ongoing rage cost for first X 1000ms

name: Shock Siphon
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Energy Shield when it kills a Shocked enemy.

name: Shock Conduction
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy.

name: Shock Conduction II
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy. Always Shocks enemies which are Drenched.

name: Deep Freeze
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Freeze it inflicts to last longer.

name: Thunderstorm
desc: Conjure a thunderstorm which causes lightning strikes and torrential rain in an area. Enemies in the area are Drenched, causing them to become Shocked or Frozen more easily. Plants in the area become Overgrown.
nText: Thunderstorm wet debuff shock chance on +10%

name: Ignite I
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.

name: Ignite II
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.

name: Ignite III
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite and causing inflicted Ignites to deal their damage more quickly.

name: Searing Flame I
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

name: Searing Flame II
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

name: Eternal Flame I
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to be inflicted less often but last longer.

name: Eternal Flame II
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to last longer.

name: Eternal Flame III
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to refresh Ignites on Critical Hit.

name: Essence Harvest
desc: Supports Skills which create Reviving Persistent Minions. When those Minions die, you Recoup a percentage of your maximum Mana.

name: Furious Slam
desc: Shapeshift into a Bear and Slam the ground with great force, causing a pair of shockwaves. Can spend Rage to create larger shockwaves that leave behind Jagged Ground.

name: Ferocious Roar
desc: Shapeshift into a Bear and roar in defiance, immediately gaining Rage if there are enemies nearby and Empowering subsequent Attacks to Break Armour. Alternatively, socketing a human-form Warcry into this Skill triggers that Warcry instead, and augments its damage and area. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
nText: Bear warcry gain X centirage per enemy power 100

name: Cast on Elemental Ailment
tags: Persistent, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Meta
desc: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze, Shock, or Ignite enemies, and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

name: Cast on Melee Kill
desc: While active, gains Energy when you kill enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

name: Cast on Critical
desc: While active, gains Energy when you Critically Hit enemies and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.

name: Exploit Weakness
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more Damage against enemies with Broken Armour but preventing them from Breaking Armour themselves. Cannot support skills that Consume Broken Armour.

name: Barrier Invocation
desc: While active, gains Energy when your Energy Shield is damaged by Enemy Hits. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.

name: Cast on Dodge
desc: While active, gains Energy when you dodge roll and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

name: Cast on Melee Stun
desc: While active, gains Energy when you Stun enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

name: Enraged Warcry I
desc: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.

name: Enraged Warcry II
desc: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.

name: Lingering Illusion
desc: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will drop a Remnant that grants you a Power Charge on pickup.

name: Ghost Dance
desc: While active, causes you to periodically gain Ghost Shrouds. If you are Hit while you have a Ghost Shroud, it is immediately consumed to recover Energy Shield based on your Evasion.

name: Ancestral Warrior Totem
tags: Attack, AoE, Melee, Duration, Conditional, Meta
weapon: One Hand Mace, Two Hand Mace
desc: Consume 3 Endurance Charges to Raise a Totem that conjures spirit warriors. Each warrior uses a socketed Mace Skill once, then disappears. Cannot use Channelling Skills or Skills with Cooldowns.

name: Spell Totem
desc: Consume any combination of 3 Power and/or Endurance Charges to raise a Totem that uses socketed Spells. Cannot use Skills with Cooldowns.

name: Explosive Grenade
desc: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a devastating fiery blast when its fuse expires.

name: Flash Grenade
desc: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a Blinding, Stunning explosion when its fuse expires.

name: Oil Grenade
desc: Fire a bouncing Grenade that bursts in a spray of Oil when the fuse expires or when it impacts an Enemy, dealing minimal damage but covering the ground and nearby enemies in Oil. Oil created this way can be Ignited by Detonator Skills or Ignited Ground.

name: Gas Grenade
tags: AoE, Projectile, Grenade, Fire, Chaos, Duration
desc: Fire a bouncing Grenade that causes a burst of Poison gas when its fuse expires, damaging enemies and leaving behind a growing Poison cloud. Burning effects or Detonator skills will cause the cloud to explode in a fiery blast.

name: Voltaic Grenade
desc: Fire a bouncing Grenade that discharges an Electrocuting Lightning blast when its fuse expires, causing all Lightning Hits against enemies to contribute to Electrocution buildup for a duration.

name: Pain Offering
desc: Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike to send nearby Minions into a frenzy as long as the spike remains, making their skills faster and harder hitting.  The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.

name: Tempest Flurry
desc: Perform a series of aggressive Strikes. When used in quick succession, the third use Strikes three times, and the fourth use performs a Final Strike that calls down a powerful Shocking bolt.

name: Staggering Palm
tags: Buff, AoE, Melee, Strike, Projectile, Physical, Duration, Wind
desc: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, instantly Heavily Stunning enemies which are Primed for Stun and performing additional dashing Strikes to other Primed targets in range if your first target was Stunned. Heavy Stunning an enemy with this Skill grants you a Buff that causes your Quarterstaff Attacks to also fire Projectiles for a short duration. Heavy Stunning additional enemies adds to the Buff's duration.

name: Charged Staff
tags: Attack, Buff, AoE, Lightning, Duration, Conditional
desc: Consume all Power Charges to charge your Quarterstaff with electricity, adding Lightning damage and a Lightning shockwave to your Quarterstaff Attacks. Reusing this skill while the Buff is active adds to the Buff's duration and damage.

name: Siphoning Strike
desc: Dash to a target and Strike them with your Quarterstaff. If the target is Shocked, Consume their Shock to release a Lightning shockwave around the target and grant you a Power Charge. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.

name: Tempest Bell
desc: Build Combo by successfully Striking Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum Combo, use this skill to cause the Bell on your staff to grow to massive size as you drop it on the ground. The Bell damages enemies on impact and can be Hit by your skills, creating a damaging shockwave. Elemental Ailments applied to the Bell cause its shockwaves to deal extra damage of the corresponding type, and Hits which would have caused Knockback increase the area of effect of the shockwaves.
nText: Tempest bell damage +% final per time hit +3%

name: Chaos Bolt
desc: Fire a burst of Chaos energy at the target.

name: Coiling Bolts
desc: Simultaneously fires a Physical Projectile and a Chaos Projectile at the target. These projectiles Chain through any number of Cursed targets.

name: Frozen Locus
desc: Leap backward and crack the ground with your staff to call forth an Ice Crystal which can be damaged by you and enemies. If the Crystal is destroyed it causes an icy explosion. This skill can be used while using other skills.

name: Bonestorm
desc: Channel to conjure a swarm of bone spikes in the air, then release to fire them at enemies and explode. Shrapnel Impales enemies Hit, causing subsequent Attack Hits against those targets to deal extra damage. Consumes your Power Charges to cause much larger explosions.

name: Bone Cage
desc: Raise a ring of bone spikes around you. The spikes are destroyed when enemies touch them, damaging and Pinning those enemies. Raising a new ring of spikes destroys the previous one.

name: Neural Overload
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Nearby enemies are marked when they are Primed for Electrocution, and hitting a marked enemy with a supported skill will Electrocute them.

name: Pinpoint Critical
desc: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to Critically Hit more often but deal less damage with Critical Hits.

name: Perpetual Charge
desc: Supports skills that consume Power, Frenzy or Endurance Charges on use, giving them a chance not to remove each Charge while still gaining the benefits of consuming them.

name: Corrosion
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Poison it applies to also Break enemy Armour. Cannot support skills that Consume Fully Broken Armour.

name: Unearth
desc: Raise spikes of bone from the earth in front of you, damaging enemies. The bones of Corpses and dead Reviving Minions in the area are ripped out and reassembled into short-lived Bone Construct Minions that fight for you. Larger Corpses create more than one Bone Construct.

name: Detonating Arrow
tags: AoE, Projectile, Fire, Channelling, Detonator, Staged, Repeatable
desc: Channel to charge up before firing off a burning arrow. At maximum stages, the arrow will create a Detonating explosion at the end of its flight.
nText: Detonating arrow max number of stages 1

name: Poisonburst Arrow
desc: Fire a virulent arrow that creates a burst of Poison on hit, affecting all enemies in an area.

name: Firebolt
desc: Launch a fiery Projectile towards a target. The Projectile explodes on impact, damaging foes in a small area.

name: Toxic Growth
desc: Fire a rain of Toxic Pustules into the air. The Pustules deal damage on impact, then Detonate after a delay. They can also be Poisoned, causing them to Detonate faster and more violently.

name: Stormcaller Arrow
desc: Fire an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, a Lightning Bolt strikes the arrow, disintegrating it and damaging enemies, with a high chance to Shock. Shocking any enemy with the Bolt also applies Shock to all enemies near the impact.

name: Phantasmal Arrow
desc: Fires an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, the arrow explodes in spectral flame, turning it to ashes and damaging enemies, with a high chance to Ignite. Igniting any enemy with the Explosion also applies Ignite to enemies within range.

name: Lightning Rod
tags: AoE, Projectile, Sustained, Lightning, Duration, Repeatable
desc: Fire an arrow that drops from above, creating a Lightning burst. The arrow remains in the ground, and any Chaining Lightning beams can Chain to it. When Chained to, the arrows charge up for a brief period before releasing another Lightning burst. The Lightning Arrow Skill reduces this delay, causing bursts to happen more quickly.
nText: Lightning rod % chance for additional burst on landing 20

name: Snipe
tags: AoE, Projectile, Cold, Channelling, Payoff, Repeatable
desc: Channel to charge up your bow before releasing a powerful shot. Releasing with Perfect Timing causes the arrow to explode on impact and Consume Freeze on directly Hitting. Consuming Freeze enhances the explosion.

name: Gas Arrow
tags: AoE, Projectile, Fire, Chaos, Duration, Repeatable
desc: Fire a noxious arrow at the ground, creating a cloud of flammable poisonous gas at the end of its flight. The cloud will detonate if hit by a Detonator skill or if an Ignited enemy touches it, creating a fiery explosion.

name: Solar Orb
tags: AoE, Sustained, Fire, Duration, Orb, Repeatable
desc: Create a fiery Orb that periodically releases fiery pulses. Enemies that are very close to the Orb are Ignited. Flameblast can target a Solar Orb to be centred on the Orb instead of your location.

name: Fireball
desc: Launch a large ball of Fire which explodes on impact. The explosion Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to launch a ring of smaller firebolts.
nText: Spell skills fire 2 additional projectiles final chance +10%

name: Electrocuting Arrow
desc: Fire an electrifying arrow that explodes in an Area on Hit. Hitting an enemy will attach an Electrocuting Rod to them, causing all incoming Lightning damage to build up Electrocution. This rod is removed when the enemy is next Electrocuted.
nText: Electrocuting arrow % damage gained as extra lightning on debuffed target 10

name: Snap
tags: AoE, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Payoff, Remnant, Repeatable
desc: Consume the elemental energy from a Frozen, Shocked or Ignited enemy, creating an elemental blast that leaves behind an Infusion Remnant. The blast will spread to other enemies affected by the same Ailment, but those blasts cannot spread further. Can also be cast on a Frostbolt to create a larger cold blast.
nText: Chance % to spawn another infusion remnant +10%

name: Perfect Strike
weapon: One Hand Mace, Two Hand Mace
desc: Channel to charge up your weapon with Fire. Releasing with Perfect Timing will create a damaging wave of intense Fire.

name: Raise Shield
desc: Raise your Shield to Block all incoming Blockable hits. Release immediately after Blocking when an enemy is close to perform a Shield Bash, damaging and Stunning enemies. While your Shield is raised you cannot be Light Stunned by hits you Block, but Blocking too much damage may Heavy Stun you. You cannot Evade while your Shield is raised, but Evasion instead grants an equal chance to avoid this Heavy Stun buildup.

name: Resonating Shield
desc: Repeatedly hammer your Shield with your weapon causing damaging shockwaves in an area around you. Enemies hit by the shockwave lose Armour for a duration. While Channelling Resonating Shield, your Shield is raised and you will Block all incoming Blockable hits.

name: Mana Remnants
desc: Conjure surging arcane energy to restore your Mana. While active, enemies you kill affected by Elemental Ailments have a chance to spawn a Mana Remnant, and Critically Hitting a target with Elemental Ailments spawns a Mana Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Mana Remnant grants you Mana which can Overflow maximum Mana.
nText: Mana remnants mana gain per globe 40

name: Sanguine Revelry
desc: Conjure hateful energy to fuel your Rage and Life. While active, Bleeding enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Hateful Remnant, and Hitting a Bleeding target spawns a Hateful Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Hateful Remnant grants you Rage and recovers Life based on your current Rage.
nText: Sanguine revelry rage gain per pickup 2

name: Magma Barrier
tags: Attack, Persistent, AoE, Melee, Trigger, Fire
desc: While active, increases your Block Chance passively and imbues your Shield with lava over time. When fully imbued, your next Block with your Shield raised will expend the lava to Trigger the Magma Spray skill and grant you an Endurance Charge.

name: Freezing Shards
desc: Launch icy Projectiles in a sweeping arc. Multiple Projectiles can hit the same enemy.

name: Vine Arrow
tags: AoE, Projectile, Chaos, Duration, Repeatable, Plant
desc: Fire an arrow into the air that lands after a short delay, damaging enemies and causing a plant to spring up at the impact location. The plant sprouts vines that latch onto nearby enemies, Slowing their movement speed and dealing Chaos damage over time. The plant can be Poisoned, causing it to deal more damage.
nText: Poison vine arrow vine stored poison damage +10%

name: Rhoa Mount
desc: Harnesses a Companion Rhoa you can mount while you're wielding a Bow or Spear. While mounted you can use Bow, thrown Spear, and Mark Skills, and are much less slowed while using Skills, but being Hit will cause Heavy Stun buildup. While you aren't mounted, the Rhoa will attack your enemies alongside you with its beak, but can be damaged.

name: Bursting Plague
desc: Supports skills that can Poison enemies, causing Poisoned enemies to gain Plague over time and explode in a Plague Burst on death. Cannot support the skills of Minions.

name: Decompose
desc: Consume a Corpse to create a cloud of flammable Poisonous gas. Any Burning effects or Detonator skills will explode the gas cloud, creating a fiery explosion.

name: Fortress I
desc: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage.

name: Fortress II
desc: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage and have lowered Area of Effect.

name: Ahn's Citadel
desc: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to instead be created along a fissure.

name: Frostfire
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Consume Freeze on Igniting a Frozen enemy to boost the effect of the Ignite.

name: Stormfire
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Enemies Shocked by Supported Skills take a percentage of damage from Ignite as Lightning damage as well as Fire damage.

name: Overabundance I
desc: Supports Skills which have a Limit, increasing that Limit at the cost of their duration. Only applies to restrictions that use the word \"Limit\".

name: Overabundance II
desc: Supports Skills which have a Limit, increasing that Limit at the cost of their duration. Only applies to restrictions that use the word \"Limit\".

name: Electrocute
desc: Supports any Skill which can deal Damage. Lightning Damage from Supported Skills can inflict Electrocute, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Shock.

name: Eonyr's Thunder
desc: Supports any Skill which can deal damage. Lightning damage from Supported Skills can inflict Electrocute, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Shock. Enemies slain while Electrocuted by Supported Skills explode, dealing a percentage of their maximum Life as Lightning damage.

name: Raging Spirits
desc: While active, Fire Spells you use yourself will also summon Raging Spirits, which are short-lived flaming skulls that rush at nearby enemies and rapidly Attack them, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them.

name: Wind Wave
desc: Supports any skill that you can use, triggering a blast of wind that Knocks Back enemies if you are Stunned while using it.

name: Biting Frost I
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage to Frozen enemies but consume their Freeze. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

name: Biting Frost II
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage to Frozen enemies but consume their Freeze, leaving them Chilled. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

name: Elemental Discharge
tags: Spell, AoE, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Payoff
desc: Supports any Spell that Hits enemies, causing it to consume Elemental Ailments on hit to trigger an Elemental Discharge. Cannot support the skills of Minions.

name: Hourglass
desc: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal significantly more damage but gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

name: Fiery Death
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it Ignites to have a chance to explode on death.

name: Twister
desc: Whip up a twister with a flick of your Spear. The twister moves forward erratically, Blinding and repeatedly Hitting enemies within. If a twister touches a Whirlwind from your other skills, it Consumes the Whirlwind to create additional twisters that deal more damage. Passing over Elemental Ground Surfaces or Consuming an elemental Whirlwind will grant twisters extra damage of that element.

name: Detonate Minion
desc: Detonate an allied Minion whose current Life is below a threshold, dealing heavy Attack damage to nearby enemies.
nText: Arsonist destructive link % of life as fire damage 4

name: Explosive Spear
tags: AoE, Projectile, Fire, Duration, Detonator, Repeatable
desc: Hurl a single payload Spear that pierces through enemies and lodges in terrain where it lands. The Spear will explode at the end of its Detonation Time or if Detonated. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if you have one to explode immediately, dealing more damage in a cross-shaped area and creating Ignited Ground.

name: Thunderous Leap
tags: AoE, Melee, Slam, Lightning, Detonator, Travel
desc: Leap into the air and plunge your Spear into the ground at the target location, emitting a Lightning-charged shockwave.
nText: Thunderous leap % chance for shocked ground when detonating 30

name: Wind Dancer
tags: Attack, Persistent, AoE, Melee, Trigger, Staged
desc: While active, periodically grants stages of a buff that gives you more Evasion per stage. Being Hit by an Enemy while you have this buff consumes all stages to damage and Knock Back enemies around you.

name: Deadly Herald
desc: Supports Herald Skills, making their triggered effects deal more damage at the expense of higher Spirit cost.

name: Mana Flare
desc: Supports any Spell that Hits enemies, causing it to trigger a Mana Flare on Critical Hit. The Mana Flare consumes your Mana to deal Fire damage. Cannot support the skills of Minions.

name: Lockdown
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing any Pin buildup it inflicts to be stronger the closer the enemy is to you.

name: Stun I
desc: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.

name: Stun II
desc: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.

name: Stun III
desc: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun significantly more quickly, at the cost of Damage.

name: Mobility
desc: Supports skills that can be used while moving, allowing you to move faster while using them.

name: Pin I
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun.

name: Pin II
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun, as well as granting Critial Hit Chance against Immobilised enemies.

name: Pin III
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun. Pin buildup caused by Supported Skill is lessened, but Pin duration is significantly longer.

name: Ambush
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Critically Hit enemies on full life.

name: Profane Ritual
desc: Mark a Corpse with a profane rune, dealing Chaos damage over time to nearby enemies. When the ritual is complete the Corpse is consumed and you gain a Power Charge.

name: Soul Offering
desc: Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike, granting you a powerful Spell damage Buff as long as the spike remains. Does not affect your Minions.  The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.

name: Dark Effigy
desc: Raise a Totem that bombards enemies afflicted by Chaos damage over time Debuffs.

name: Bounty I
desc: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Flask and Charm charges.

name: Bounty II
desc: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Flask and Charm charges.

name: Mana Bounty
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it kills to grant more Mana Flask charges.

name: Life Bounty
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it kills to grant more Life Flask charges.

name: Skeletal Warrior
desc: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Warriors.

name: Minion Instability
desc: Supports skills which create Minions, causing them to violently explode when reduced to Low Life.

name: Heightened Curse
desc: Supports Curse Skills, magnifying their power.

name: Corpse Conservation
desc: Supports skills that consume Corpses, giving them a chance to take effect without destroying the Corpse.

name: Decaying Hex
desc: Supports Curse skills. Supported skill Trigger Profane Decay on each target they curse to inflict a damaging Debuff.

name: Focused Curse
desc: Supports Curse skills, causing them to Curse enemies more quickly after being cast.

name: Ritualistic Curse
desc: Supports Curse skills, causing them to cover a larger area but take longer to Curse enemies.

name: Minion Pact I
desc: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.

name: Minion Pact II
desc: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.

name: Last Gasp
desc: Supports Skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on when they are fatally wounded, dying after a short duration.

name: Tecrod's Revenge
desc: Supports Skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on when they are fatally wounded, dying after a duration. Minions from Supported Skills gain Soul Eater and a burst of speed on entering this state.

name: Life Drain
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Life when it Culls an enemy.

name: Soul Drain
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Mana when it Culls an enemy.

name: Grim Feast
desc: While active, your Reviving Minions store a percentage of their maximum Life in a collectible Grim Remnant on death. Using Grim Resurrection Consumes the Life you've collected to Revive up to that much total Life of dead Minions.
nText: Grim remnant health stored in globe +5%

name: Innervate
desc: Supports damaging skills you use yourself. Killing a Shocked enemy with supported skills imbues your damage with Lightning damage for a short time.

name: Cast on Minion Death
desc: While active, gains Energy when one of your Persistent Minions is Killed, and triggers socketed Spells upon reaching maximum Energy. Very underlevelled Minions will incur an Energy generation penalty. Cannot socket Spells which create Minions.

name: Escalating Poison
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing it to inflict an extra Poison on enemies but shortening the duration of those Poisons.

name: Charge Profusion I
desc: Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so.

name: Charge Profusion II
desc: Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so, as well as a chance to generate an additional Charge of a random type.

name: Murderous Intent
desc: Supports skills that can Empower skills other than themselves, causing skills they Empower to Cull enemies.

name: Scavenged Plating
desc: While active, uses fragments of armour scavenged from enemies to bolster your own. Fully Breaking an enemy's Armour grants you stacks of Scavenged Plating for a duration based on the enemy's Rarity, and you gain Armour and Thorns per stack. Normal enemies grant 1 stack, Magic enemies grant 2 stacks, Rare enemies grant 5 stacks and Unique enemies grant 10 stacks.

name: Mana Drain
desc: Leech Mana from an enemy over a prolonged period, as well as briefly Hindering them.
nText: Mana drain base mana leech amount 90

name: Bone Blast
desc: Conjure a circle of ritual inscriptions that last for a short duration. When the duration ends, spikes of bone erupt from enemies in the area, damaging them and potentially causing Bleeding.

name: Blink
desc: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown Spell that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.

name: Black Powder Blitz
tags: Persistent, AoE, Physical, Fire, Detonator, Travel
desc: Replaces your dodge roll with an explosive-assisted leap, firing off a round from your prosthetic cannon leg that Blinds and Ignites enemies in the area you escape from. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.

name: Molten Blast
weapon: One Hand Mace, Two Hand Mace
desc: Gouge molten rock from the ground and fling it at the target. The Projectile explodes on collision, damaging enemies and scattering shrapnel in a cone behind it.

name: Malice
desc: While active, emits an Aura that continuously inflicts Critical Weakness on enemies in your Presence.

name: Hammer of the Gods
weapon: One Hand Mace, Two Hand Mace
desc: Build Glory by Heavy Stunning enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may entreat the Ancestors to crush your enemies, manifesting a massive hammer that falls from the sky onto your target, Slamming into the ground after a short duration and dealing immense damage based on your weapon.

name: Living Bomb
desc: Plant a seed of Fire inside an enemy. Dealing enough damage to the enemy, or killing it outright, causes the seed to explode, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind a Fire Infusion Remnant.

name: Stampede
weapon: One Hand Mace, Two Hand Mace
desc: Charges forward, cracking the earth and leaving a patch of Jagged Ground with every footstep. At the end of your charge, a massive leaping Slam damages enemies and causes all nearby patches of Jagged Ground to explode, damaging enemies standing on them. Once you begin your charge, the use speed of this Skill is affected by movement speed instead of Attack speed.

name: Shield Wall
desc: Ram your Shield into the ground, throwing up a wall of earth. Enemies can attack your wall segments, and your Slams, Warcries, and Shield Charge will instantly shatter them all. The segments explode when shattered, damaging enemies in front of and around them.
nText: Shield wall damage +% final when slammed +40%

name: Fortifying Cry
tags: Attack, AoE, Melee, Trigger, Physical, Duration, Nova
desc: Perform a Warcry that grants Guard and Triggers Shield Wave when subsequent Shield Attacks deal damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.

name: Ember Fusillade
desc: Conjure a blazing Ember that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Ember launches at an enemy, dealing Fire damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Embers. Multiple Embers fired in the same Fusillade will attempt to target different enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to cause the entire Fusillade to create beams that Chain to enemies.
nText: Ember fusillade damage +% final per ember fired +2%

name: His Scattering Calamity
desc: Conjure a crackling Wellsprite that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Wellsprite launches at an enemy, dealing Lightning damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Wellsprites.
nText: Ember fusillade damage +% final per ember fired +2%

name: High Velocity Rounds
desc: Load your Crossbow with Piercing bolts that apply Riven Armour to enemies with Fully Broken Armour, causing any Hits against those enemies to deal extra damage.

name: Fragmentation Rounds
desc: Load your Crossbow with Piercing bolts that fragment in flight. Bolts that hit a Frozen enemy Consume the Freeze and cause an explosion of shrapnel. Bolts that hit an Ice Crystal cause it to explode. These fragments can Merge.

name: Siege Cascade
desc: Load your Crossbow with enemy-seeking payloads which are fired into the air, dropping a bolt near every enemy in the target area. These bolts lodge in the ground and explode after a short delay.

name: Armour Piercing Rounds
desc: Load your Crossbow with a clip of bolts that can be fired rapidly and Break enemy Armour. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

name: Explosive Shot
desc: Load your Crossbow with flaming bolts that explode on impact. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.

name: Incendiary Shot
desc: Load your Crossbow with flaming bolts that fragment in flight, damaging and Igniting enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. These fragments can Merge.

name: Rapid Shot
desc: Load your Crossbow with a large clip of heated bolts. Heat builds up on your Crossbow as you fire them, and reaching maximum Heat will prevent you from firing or reloading these bolts for a short time. However, other Skills can Consume Heat for extra benefits. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

name: Glacial Bolt
desc: Load your Crossbow with icy bolts that create two walls of Ice Crystals at the end of their flight.

name: Permafrost Bolts
desc: Load your Crossbow with icy bolts that fragment in flight, damaging enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. The icy coating on the bolts makes them extremely potent at Freezing enemies. These fragments can Merge.

name: Hailstorm Rounds
desc: Passively generate bolts of ice at a frequency equal to reload time, up to a cap. Activate to Load the accumulated bolts into your Crossbow. All loaded bolts are fired at once, causing them to rain down over the target area.

name: Ice Shards
tags: AoE, Ammunition, Projectile, Sustained, Cold, Hazard
desc: Load your Crossbow with a clip of icy bolts that rapidly fire at the ground, leaving a shard of ice at the impact location that arms after a duration. After arming, the ice shards explode when enemies step on them, dealing more damage the longer they have been armed, up to a maximum. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

name: Plasma Blast
desc: Load your Crossbow with unstable bolts that require a lengthy charging period to fire but deal devastating damage, Pierce through enemies, and explode upon hitting terrain. Additional Projectiles are fired in a spread, unlike other Crossbow Skills.

name: Galvanic Shards
desc: Load your Crossbow with charged bolts that fragment in flight, releasing Chaining Lightning beams when they Hit enemies. These fragments can Merge.

name: Stormblast Bolts
desc: Load your Crossbow with charged bolts that land around the target location and explode if hit by a Detonator Skill. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

name: Shockburst Rounds
