desc: Load your Crossbow with a clip of charged bolts which release damaging pulses upon Hitting an enemy affected by a Lightning Ailment. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

name: Raging Cry
desc: Supports Warcry skills, causing them to grant you Rage on use depending on counted monster Power.

name: Armour Demolisher I
desc: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.

name: Armour Demolisher II
desc: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.

name: Uruk's Smelting
desc: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger. Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills permanently increases the Physical Damage taken by those affected, up to a cap.

name: Rageforged I
desc: Supports any damaging skill that you use or Trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.

name: Rageforged II
desc: Supports any damaging skill that you use or Trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage, with a chance to skip spending Rage while still benefitting as though it had. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.

name: Quarterstaff Strike
desc: Strike with your Quarterstaff.

name: Mace Strike
desc: Strike with your Mace.

name: Spear Stab
desc: Strike with your Spear.

name: Spear Throw
desc: Hurl your Spear with force. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if you have one to cause the Spear to explode at the end of its flight.

name: Bow Shot
desc: Fire an arrow with your Bow.

name: Crossbow Shot
desc: Fire a bolt from your crossbow.

name: Grenade
desc: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a shrapnel blast when its fuse expires.

name: Life Remnants
desc: Drink the blood of your enemies to restore your Life. While active, enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Life Remnant, and Hitting a target spawns a Life Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Life Remnant grants you Life which can Overflow maximum Life.
nText: Life remnants chance to spawn orb on killing enemy +10%

name: Explosive Concoction
desc: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Fire Attack damage in an area. Additional smaller flasks are thrown at nearby Ignited Enemies. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack
nText: Explosive concoction number of secondary projectiles 2

name: Fulminating Concoction
desc: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Lightning Attack damage in an area with high chance to Shock. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack

name: Shattering Concoction
desc: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Cold Attack damage in an area and inflicting Exposure. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack

name: Acidic Concoction
desc: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Physical Attack damage in an area. The thrown flask Consumes Poison on Hit to cause an acidic burst. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack

name: Bleeding Concoction
desc: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Physical Attack damage in an area and Aggravating Bleeding on Enemies hit. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack

name: Meditate
desc: Channel to Recharge Energy Shield and allow that Recharge to Overflow. Channelling ends when you take damage or your Energy Shield is fully Overflowed.

name: Elemental Storm
tags: AoE, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration, Orb
desc: Create a stationary Fire, Cold or Lightning storm at a target location for a duration, based on the highest Elemental Damage type for the Hit that Triggered the storm. Hits which do not deal Elemental Damage will not Trigger the storm.

name: Unbound Avatar
desc: Gain Unbound Fury by inflicting Elemental Ailments with Hits on enemies. Once you reach maximum Unbound Fury, consume it to become Unbound for a duration, vastly augmenting your Elemental prowess.

name: Summon Infernal Hound
desc: Activate to summon a Reviving Infernal Hound which Ignites enemies near it.

name: Navira, the Last Mirage
desc: Summon Navira, an invulnerable Water Djinn Minion to do your bidding. Navira will only act when you Command her to do so, bestowing restorative blessings upon you and your Allies with her Spells.

name: Ruzhan, the Blazing Sword
desc: Summon Ruzhan, an invulnerable Flame Djinn Minion, to do your bidding. Ruzhan emerges to Strike enemies with his greatsword whenever you use a damaging Skill, and casts devastating Fire Spells when Commanded to do so.

name: Kelari, the Tainted Sands
desc: Summon Kelari, an invulnerable Sand Djinn Minion, to do your bidding. Kelari will only act when you Command him to do so. Kelari delivers swift Hits with massive Critical Hit potential.

name: Kelari's Malediction
desc: Harness Kelari's power to passively Consume Corpses in your Presence, causing Corpse Beetle Minions to burst forth. The Beetles passively follow you until Commanded. On your Command, they rush the target and explode.

name: Align Fate
desc: While active, visages of yourself from alternate timelines will occasionally appear and cast one of your Spells from your first valid Weapon Set. Until the next visage appears, your next cast of the same Spell aligns your fate, Empowering that Spell. Visages can only cast damaging, non-Channelling, non-Buff Spells you could cast that have no cooldown.

name: Moment of Vulnerability
desc: Send out a temporal Nova to take advantage of enemies' moment of vulnerability. Hitting enemies that are Primed for Stun, Electrocution, or Freeze causes a visage of them to appear, lasting as long as the original target would have been affected by the form of Immobilisation used to create the visage. A portion of the damage dealt to visages is also dealt to the original.

name: Temporal Rift
desc: While active, passively leaves afterimages of your recent past. Cast the Spell to return to the oldest afterimage, teleporting to that location and resetting your Life, Mana and Energy Shield to the values they had at the time. Removes any upcoming damage delayed by Phased Form on use.

name: Time Freeze
desc: Release a large wave that stops time for all affected enemies for a duration. Duration is lower the more times the enemy has had time stopped for them.

name: Time Snap
desc: Manipulate time, resetting the cooldowns of your other Skills.

name: Encase in Jade
desc: Consume all stacks of Jade to grant Guard based off your maximum Life for each Jade consumed. You cannot gain Jade stacks while you have Guard.
nText: Maximum life % damage absorbed per jade consumed 1

name: Demon Form
desc: Shapeshift into a demon, vastly boosting the power of your Spells. You gain Demonflame every second you remain in demon form, causing your Life to be lost at an ever-increasing rate. Maximum 10 Demonflame. Revert to human form if you reach 1 Life, use a Skill that isn't a Spell, or reactivate this Skill.

name: Sorcery Ward
desc: Passively manifests a protective barrier which takes Elemental Damage from Hits for you until depleted. The barrier instantly recharges to its full value a short time after it stops taking damage or is fully depleted.
nText: Aegis unique shield max value from % armour evasion 5

name: Into the Breach
desc: Create a Breach around you, allowing you to see nearby Flames of Chayula. You are considered to be in a Breach while this skill is active.

name: Ancestral Spirits
desc: This skill is Triggered each time you summon a Totem, summoning an Ancestral Spirit Minion to fight for you. If the Totem dies then the Ancestral Spirit triggered by it's summoning will die too.

name: Ritual Sacrifice
desc: Sacrifice the Corpse of a Rare Monster to grant you its Modifiers for a duration, or gain a single random Modifier at the cost of your own life force.

name: Blood Boil
desc: Enemies in your Presence accumulate blood boils periodically. When they die, the boils pop applying Corrupted Blood to enemies near them.

name: Vivid Stampede
desc: Call upon Spirits of the Stag, sending them leaping forward. Each Stag releases a damaging shockwave each time it lands, and any Stags that travel the maximum possible distance also leave behind Shocked Ground.

name: Wild Protector
desc: Call upon a Bear Spirit Companion to maul your foes. The Bear Spirit leaps at enemies to Maim them, Leeches Life with its slam, and periodically roars to Intimidate enemies. The Bear Spirit does not count toward your Companion limit.

name: Hollow Form
desc: Channel to create fleeting images of your astral self near the target location. The images perform a Socketed Melee Attack once then vanish, targeting the closest enemy if possible. The images cannot perform Channelled Skills or Conditional Skills. Consuming a Power Charge creates additional images.

name: Hollow Focus
desc: While active, ethereal bells periodically appear near you. Your Hits immediately destroy the bells, creating a shockwave that damages nearby enemies and causes a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. The bells are themselves always Primed for Stun, they can be Culled, and Hits against them are always Critical Hits.

name: Hollow Resonance
desc: Attaches an ethereal bell to your back. Critical Hits with other Skills will cause the bell to ring out, damaging nearby enemies.

name: Mirage Deadeye
desc: While active, firing a ranged Projectile Attack will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged Attacks for a short duration, then vanish.

name: Inevitable Agony
desc: Debuff all targets in an area, causing a portion of Damage they take from Hits to be tracked by the Debuff. When the debuff's duration expires or can kill the target, the target loses life equal to that tracked damage all at once.

name: Called Shots
desc: Applies a socketed Mark Skill to a nearby unmarked Enemy every few seconds. Consuming socketed Marks will cause them to be reapplied to an unmarked Enemy. This reapplication can happen at most once every few seconds.

name: Fire Spell on Hit
desc: While active, gains Energy when you Hit enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed Fire spells on reaching maximum Energy.

name: Manifest Weapon
desc: Manifest a copy of your main hand Melee Martial Weapon as an immortal Companion to fight by your side. In addition to its standard Strikes, the Manifested Weapon gains an additional Attack depending on its weapon type.

name: Temper Weapon
tags: Buff, AoE, Melee, Trigger, Fire, Channelling
desc: Channel to temper your main hand Melee Martial Weapon. Each hit of the hammer against the anvil Empowers subsequent Attacks to Combust when Hitting enemies.

name: Supporting Fire
desc: Recruit artillery Minions that take up positions behind you. They will lie in wait for your Command, then fire volleys of arrows at the target location.

name: Void Illusion
desc: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will cause damaging explosions. Copies created this way have 1 Life.

name: Armour Explosion
tags: Attack, Warcry, AoE, Trigger, Fire, Payoff
desc: Supports Attacks and Warcries, causing them to trigger a Fiery explosion when they Fully Break an enemy's Armour.

name: Stomping Ground
desc: Supports Travel skills, causing your footsteps to crack the earth and emit damaging shockwaves while using the skill.

name: Crescendo I
desc: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession.

name: Crescendo II
desc: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession, and causing Non-Final Strike Attacks to be faster.

name: Crescendo III
desc: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to be Ancestrally Boosted.

name: Fire Exposure
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when Igniting.

name: Lightning Exposure
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when inflicting Shock.

name: Cold Exposure
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when it Critically Hits an enemy.

name: Deadly Poison I
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Poison.

name: Deadly Poison II
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Poison.

name: Deep Cuts I
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Bleeding.

name: Deep Cuts II
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Bleeding.

name: Corrupting Cry I
desc: Supports Warcries, Triggering Corrupted Cry to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.

name: Corrupting Cry II
desc: Supports Warcries, Triggering Corrupted Cry to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.

name: Paquate's Pact
desc: Supports Warcries, Triggering Twisted Pact  to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect., at the cost of your Life.

name: Window of Opportunity I
desc: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.

name: Window of Opportunity II
desc: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage and grant Perfect Deflection if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.

name: Fire Mastery
desc: Supports Fire skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Cold Mastery
desc: Supports Cold skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Lightning Mastery
desc: Supports Lightning skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Chaos Mastery
desc: Supports Chaos skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Physical Mastery
desc: Supports Physical skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Minion Mastery
desc: Supports Minion skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Shockchain Arrow
tags: AoE, Projectile, Lightning, Chaining, Payoff, Repeatable
desc: Fire a Lightning-charged arrow that homes in on enemies afflicted by Lightning Ailments. Hitting such an enemy will cause your arrow to release a damaging shockwave and Chain towards nearby targets, with those Chaining Hits also releasing a shockwave. After the final Chain, the arrow lodges into the ground as a Lightning Rod. Consumes Shock from enemies it Hits, but not Electrocution.

name: Vaulting Impact
tags: AoE, Melee, Slam, Physical, Duration, Travel, Payoff
desc: Leap forward and Slam the ground, sending out a shockwave. The shockwave applies Broken Stance to Dazed enemies, causing any Hits against those enemies to deal extra damage.

name: Storm Wave
desc: Sweep your Quarterstaff, projecting a bolt of Lightning through the ground in a long fissure ahead of you.

name: Mantra of Destruction
desc: Build Combo by successfully Striking Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum Combo, use this skill to Empower your next Quarterstaff Attack, causing it to deal additional Chaos damage. Each kill with the Empowered Attack grants\nPurple Flames of Chayula for a duration.

name: Swift Affliction I
desc: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.

name: Swift Affliction II
desc: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.

name: Swift Affliction III
desc: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing effects with a duration of one second or less to deal more non-Ailment damage over time.

name: Intense Agony
desc: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to have a shorter duration but deal substantially more damage over time with Debuffs inflicted against enemies on full life.

name: Drain Ailments
desc: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to consume Ailments on enemies it applies damage over time Debuffs to in order to deal substantially more damage over time.

name: Chaotic Freeze
desc: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment Chaos damage over time. Enemies taking damage over time from Debuffs caused by supported skills will suffer Freeze build up from Chaos damage Hits from any source. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

name: Combo Finisher I
desc: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo.

name: Combo Finisher II
desc: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal massively more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo.

name: Ailith's Chimes
desc: Supports Skills which can expend Combo. On expending Combo with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain Power Charges based on the amount of Combo expended.

name: Slow Potency
desc: Supports any skill, causing inflicted Slows to be more powerful.

name: Precision I
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Accuracy while the Skill is active.

name: Precision II
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Accuracy while the Skill is active.

name: Clarity I
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.

name: Clarity II
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.

name: Vitality I
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.

name: Vitality II
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.

name: Herbalism I
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Life recovery from Flasks while the Skill is active.

name: Herbalism II
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Life recovery from Flasks while the Skill is active.

name: Cannibalism I
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.

name: Cannibalism II
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.

name: Rupture
desc: Supports skills that Hit Enemies. Supported skills Aggravate Bleeding on Hitting Heavily Stunned Enemies.

name: Culling Strike I
desc: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit.

name: Culling Strike II
desc: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit, and increasing the threshold at which they will Cull Enemies.

name: Spell Cascade
desc: Supports Cascadable Spells, causing them to Cascade to either side of the target area, along a randomly chosen axis.

name: Armour Break I
desc: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.

name: Armour Break II
desc: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt. On Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain an Endurance Charge.

name: Armour Break III
desc: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt. On Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain an Endurance Charge.

name: Longshot I
desc: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage from farther away.

name: Longshot II
desc: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage from farther away.

name: Daze
desc: Supports Attacks, causing them to build up Daze based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.

name: Cursed Ground
desc: Supports Curse Skills. Supported Curse Skills create areas which Curse Enemies so long as they are within them.

name: Doedre's Undoing
tags: Lineage, Spell, AoE, Trigger, Chaos, Curse
desc: Supports Curse Skills. Supported Skills create an area which Curses Enemies within it, and spawns Witchtoads in that area. Witchtoads leap at eneimes that get close, and seek out Cursed enemies with higher aggression. Dark Consequences will be Triggered when they hit enemies with their leap, violently exploding the Witchtoad.

name: Hayoxi's Fulmination
tags: Lineage, Spell, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Chaos, Curse
desc: Supports Curse Skills, giving them a short cooldown but causing them to create areas which Curse enemies so long as they are within them. Cursed areas from Supported Skills gather power before erupting in a column of annihilating light after a moderate delay.

name: Zerphi's Infamy
desc: Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Supported Skills gain a Glory requirement, and build Glory when you spend Life on Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage and have significantly\n increased area of effect.

name: Helbrym's Hide
desc: Supports Shapeshifting Skills, causing them to grant Helbrym's Composure for a brief duration when they cause you to Shapeshift. Shapeshifting into a different form before the Buff expires causes it to be removed without effect.

name: Elemental Armament I
desc: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Elemental damage.

name: Elemental Armament II
desc: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Elemental damage.

name: Elemental Armament III
desc: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Damage for each Elemental Ailment on Enemies they Hit. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Elemental Ailments.

name: Cooldown Recovery I
desc: Supports skills with Cooldowns, increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Cooldown Recovery II
desc: Supports skills with Cooldowns, increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Elemental Expression
tags: AoE, Projectile, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Chaining
desc: Create a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave of projectiles. The chance for an explosion is proportional to your Strength, for a bolt proportional to your Dexterity, and for a wave proportional to your Intelligence.

name: Ice Shot
desc: Fire an icy arrow that sprays a cone of ice shards when it hits a target.

name: War Banner
tags: Buff, Persistent, AoE, Aura, Duration, Conditional
desc: While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Attack damage, Attack speed and Accuracy.

name: Defiance Banner
tags: Buff, Persistent, AoE, Aura, Duration, Conditional
desc: While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Armour, Evasion and movement speed.

name: Dread Banner
tags: Buff, Persistent, AoE, Aura, Duration, Conditional
desc: While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Elemental Ailment Threshold, Maximum Elemental Resistances and Flask charges.

name: Freezing Mark
desc: Mark a target, making them more susceptible to being Frozen. When the Marked target is Frozen, the Mark Activates, granting you a Buff which gives extra Cold damage and Consuming the Mark. Marking another target while you have the Buff will remove the Buff.
nText: Freezing mark hit damage freeze multiplier +20%

name: Voltaic Mark
desc: Mark a target, making them more susceptible to being Electrocuted. When the Marked target is Electrocuted, the Mark Activates, granting a Buff which gives extra Lightning damage and Consuming the Mark. Marking another target while you have the Buff will remove the Buff.
nText: Thaumaturgist mark hit damage electrocute multiplier +20%

name: Hand of Chayula
desc: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, triggering socketed Marks with increased effect and applying socketed Curses with increased duration.

name: Time of Need
desc: While active, periodically invokes divine blessings to heal you and remove Curses and Elemental Ailments from you.
nText: Time of need gain x life 40

name: Elemental Invocation
tags: Persistent, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Invocation, Meta
desc: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze, Shock or Ignite an enemy. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.

name: Attrition
desc: While active, causes you to deal more Hit damage to Rare and Unique enemies the longer you've been fighting them, and gain Culling Strike against them once you've been fighting them for long enough.
nText: Attrition culling strike at x or more stacks -5

name: Elemental Conflux
desc: Tap into a current of raw and unpredictable Elemental power, causing you to deal greatly more damage of a randomly chosen Element. The Element affected changes frequently, though the same Element can be affected multiple times in succession.

name: Emergency Reload
desc: Instantly reload all your Crossbow Ammunition clips and Empower each clip's Ammunition to deal more damage for a duration.

name: Font of Blood
desc: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Blood which will Leech Life to Allies within it.

name: Font of Mana
desc: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Mana which will Leech Mana to Allies within it.

name: Aftershock I
desc: Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.

name: Aftershock II
desc: Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.

name: Tectonic Slams
desc: Supports Slams you use yourself, causing them to create simultaneous Aftershocks behind the Slam, but lowering Aftershock damage and area of effect with Supported Skills. Cannot Support Skills which create Fissures.

name: Cluster Grenade
desc: Fire a bouncing Grenade that explodes when its fuse expires, throwing out a ring of mini Grenades that explode when they come to a stop.

name: Tornado Shot
tags: AoE, Projectile, Physical, Duration, Repeatable, Wind
desc: Fire a skyward shot that whips up a Tornado where it lands, dealing Physical damage over time and Hindering enemies standing in it. Arrows, thrown Spears and Crossbow bolts fired at the Tornado are sucked into it, causing the Tornado to spit out a ring of copied Projectiles. Copied Projectiles cannot be copied again, even by further Tornados.

name: Charge Regulation
desc: While active, you gain powerful Buffs based on your active Charges. However, maintaining the Buff Consumes Charges every few seconds.
nText: Consume frenzy power and endurance charge every x 2400ms

name: Holy Descent
desc: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Consecrated Ground when you land.

name: Burning Inscription
desc: Supports any Skill which creates Runic Inscriptions when Cast, causing those Runic Inscriptions to trigger Burning Inscription when they expire. Burning Inscription is a Spell which creates Ignited Ground based off of your Maximum Mana.

name: Shard Scavenger
tags: Persistent, Physical, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration
desc: While active, Consuming Freeze, Shock, Ignite, or Fully Broken Armour on an enemy reloads your Crossbow, restores one cooldown use for your Grenades and grants a Buff causing Crossbow Attacks to not consume bolts for a duration. This can only occur once every few seconds.

name: Double Barrel I
desc: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.

name: Double Barrel II
desc: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.

name: Double Barrel III
desc: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed. Supported Skills will also automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

name: Ratha's Assault
desc: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load multiple extra bolts and attack faster. Supported Skills cannot reload normally, instead loading bolts when you Dodge.

name: Auto Reload
desc: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

name: Ammo Conservation I
desc: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.

name: Ammo Conservation II
desc: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.

name: Ammo Conservation III
desc: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing, at the cost of Reload speed.

name: Arjun's Medal
desc: Supports Crossbow Skills, causing them to load a bolt into all Crossbow Ammunition on kill.

name: Nimble Reload
desc: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to Reload bolts significantly faster.

name: Fresh Clip I
desc: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 6 seconds.

name: Fresh Clip II
desc: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 8 seconds.

name: Sacrificial Lamb I
desc: Supports Skills which create Minions, causing your Skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill before your other Minions where possible.

name: Sacrificial Lamb II
desc: Supports Skills which create Minions, causing your Skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill before your other Minions where possible, as well as causing them to always be considered Detonatable.

name: Overwhelming Presence
desc: While active, emits an Aura that makes enemies in your Presence easier to Stun and inflict Elemental Ailments upon.

name: Alchemist's Boon
desc: While active, grants you Flask charges passively and causes Life and Mana recovery from your Flasks to also apply to Allies in your Presence.
nText: Alchemists boon generate x charges for any flask per minute 2

name: Reaper's Invocation
desc: While active, gains Energy when you kill an enemy with a Melee Attack. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.

name: Sacrifice
desc: While active, your undead Reviving Minions can be used in place of Corpses by your skills, but your Minions Revive more slowly.

name: Archmage
desc: While active, causes your Non-Channelling Spells to cost additional mana and deal extra Lightning damage, both based on your maximum Mana.

name: Magnetic Salvo
desc: Aim skyward and fire energy missiles at lingering bolts or arrows created by other Lightning Attacks in front of you. The missiles explode if they land close to a lingering bolt or arrow, dealing more damage in a larger area but destroying that bolt or arrow in the process.

name: Freezing Salvo
desc: Passively gains Seals over time. Using the skill fires a projectile, and breaks the Seals, Repeating for each of them, and for each additional projectile the skill is given. For each time it Repeats normally, it will also Repeat an additional time targeting a different Ice Fragment in its area of effect if able, Detonating those Ice Fragments immediately.

name: Berserk
desc: While active, strengthens your Rage, but causes you to lose Life while not losing Rage.

name: Herald of Plague
desc: While active, killing a Poisoned enemy spreads its Poison to other nearby enemies, and has a chance to also Hinder them.

name: Herald of Blood
tags: Attack, Persistent, AoE, Physical, Herald, Payoff
desc: While active, killing an enemy with Blood Loss will cause a bloody explosion that deals Physical Attack damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your Weapon, but is partially based on their accumulated Blood Loss. The explosion destroys their Corpse if the enemy was Normal or Magic, and has a chance to Aggravate Bleeding.
nText: Herald bleeding enemies explode for % blood loss as unscalable physical damage 4

name: Withering Presence
desc: While active, emits an Aura that periodically Withers enemies in your Presence.

name: Ravenous Swarm
desc: While active and enemies are present, swarms of insects emerge from your body to pursue nearby enemies. The swarms are untargetable Minions that Attack and Poison enemies.

name: Mirage Archer
desc: While active, dodge rolling will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged Attacks for a short duration, then vanish.

name: Combat Frenzy
desc: While active, grants you a Frenzy Charge when you Freeze, Electrocute or Pin an enemy. This can only occur once every few seconds.

name: Cast on Block
desc: While active, gains Energy when you Block and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.
nText: Cast on block gain X centienergy on block 5

name: Curse on Block
desc: While active, gains Energy when you Block and triggers socketed Curses on reaching maximum Energy.

name: Gathering Storm
tags: AoE, Melee, Lightning, Duration, Channelling, Travel
desc: Flip backward and Channel to charge your Quarterstaff with Lightning. Releasing dashes towards the target location, damaging enemies along the way. Releasing with Perfect Timing performs a Lightning-assisted dash that releases shockwaves from enemies you dash through. Perfectly Timed dash also explodes Tempest Bells on hit creating a shockwave that deals more damage and has a larger area, leaving Shocked Ground in its wake. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.

name: Branching Fissures I
desc: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.

name: Branching Fissures II
desc: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.

name: Upheaval I
desc: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create an additional fissure at the cost of damage and speed.

name: Upheaval II
desc: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional fissures at the cost of damage and speed.

name: Kaom's Madness
desc: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create many additional fissures at the cost of damage, speed, and area of effect.

name: Lasting Ground
desc: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those surfaces to last longer.

name: Ricochet I
desc: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.

name: Ricochet II
desc: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.

name: Urgent Totems I
desc: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.

name: Urgent Totems II
desc: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.

name: Urgent Totems III
desc: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly. Totems created by Supported Skills have increased Attack and Cast Speed.

name: Long Fuse I
desc: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.

name: Long Fuse II
desc: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.

name: Payload
desc: Supports Skills which fire Grenades, giving fired Grenades a chance to activate again, but lengthening their cooldowns.

name: Potent Exposure
desc: Supports Skills which apply Exposure to Enemies, increasing the effect of applied Exposure.

name: Reinforced Totems I
desc: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.

name: Reinforced Totems II
desc: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.

name: Considered Casting
desc: Supports Spell Skills that Hit Enemies and you cast yourself, boosting Damage at the cost of Cast Speed.

name: Wildshards I
desc: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.

name: Wildshards II
desc: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.

name: Sione's Temper
desc: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have an increasingly higher chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle, resetting when they do.

name: Icicle
desc: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with lower Life.

name: Glacier
desc: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with higher Life.

name: Heft
desc: Supports Skills which deal Damage, increasing the maximum Physical Damage of their Hits.

name: Rising Tempest
desc: Supports Skills which deal Damage, raising Elemental Damage dealt for each Skill used Recently of a different Elemental type. Cannot support Minion Skills.

name: Extraction
desc: Supports Spell Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Using supported Spells will cause you to Sacrifice a portion of your Life on use, gaining extra Chaos Damage in exchange. Does not support Persistent Skills, Minion Skills, or Triggered Skills.

name: Astral Projection
desc: Supports Nova Skills, causing those Skills to take place at the targeted location when used instead of around you.

name: Practiced Combo
desc: Supports Strike Skills. Supported Skills have a chance to build additional Combo on Hit. Cannot support Skills used by Minions.

name: Culmination I
desc: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

name: Culmination II
desc: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

name: Expanse
desc: Supports any Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher Area of Effect but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

name: Excise
desc: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to Critically Hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

name: Execrate
desc: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to inflict Ailments on hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

name: Energy Retention
desc: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills gain a chance to partially Refund a portion of Energy cost when Triggering or Invoking other Skills.

name: Ferocity
desc: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a Frenzy Charge on use if possible, and will gain significant Skill Speed if they do. Supported Skills cannot generate Frenzy Charges.

name: Sacrificial Offering
desc: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use, but deal much more damage and have more powerful Buffs in return.

name: Guatelitzi's Ablation
desc: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use. While Offering spikes from Supported Skills persist, you are periodically granted a Power Charge. When spikes from Supported Skills die, Regenerate a percentage of your maximum Life and Mana per second based on the duration the Offering persisted.

name: Danse Macabre
desc: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills have increased Buff effect and deal more damage, but will target an additional skeletal Minion when cast. If there is not an additional skeletal Minion to target, no damage or Buff effect will be granted.

name: Energy Capacitor
desc: Supports Invocation Skills which Trigger other Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Maximum Energy.

name: Boundless Energy I
desc: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.

name: Boundless Energy II
desc: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.

name: Harmonic Remnants I
desc: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.

name: Harmonic Remnants II
desc: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away, with a chance to create an additional Remnant.

name: Fluke
desc: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.

name: Ixchel's Torment
desc: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage, Area of Effect, and Projectile Speed randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.

name: Zenith I
desc: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage while you are above 90% of your Maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

name: Zenith II
desc: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills have increased Mana cost Efficiency and deal more damage while you are above 90% of your maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

name: Bidding I
desc: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

name: Bidding II
desc: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

name: Bidding III
desc: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions have significantly increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

name: Commandment
desc: Supports Minions which have Command Skills. Supported Minions have massively increased cooldown recovery speed for Command Skills they use, but deal no damage with non-Command Skills.

name: Adhesive Grenades I
desc: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land, but doing lower damage when they detonate.

name: Adhesive Grenades II
desc: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land.

name: Retaliate I
desc: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

name: Retaliate II
desc: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage and are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

name: Salvo
desc: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which fire Projectiles, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when used, causing additional Projectiles to be fired. Projectiles from Supported Skills are fired in random directions. Cannot Support Skills which require Combo, have a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

name: Cadence
desc: Supports Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills gain more Attack speed each time you use them, but will become unusable if used too frequently in a short time frame. Sustained Skills will instead gain Attack speed periodically while being used.

name: Volt
desc: Supports Projectile Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain Voltaic Charge as you move, up to a maximum. When used, Supported Skills expend that Charge to gain extra Lightning Damage.

name: Bone Shrapnel
desc: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies. Supported Skills trigger Bone Shrapnel explosions when killing Pinned Enemies.

name: Alignment I
desc: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

name: Alignment II
desc: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

name: Alignment III
desc: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction fire additional Projectiles. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

name: Derange
desc: Supports Skills which you use yourself which can deal damage. Supported Skills gain an Energy Shield cost equal to your Intelligence, while also dealing more non-Ailment Damage over time based off of your Intelligence. Cannot support Channelling Skills.

name: Charged Shots I
desc: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills restores a portion of its Mana cost and Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.

name: Charged Shots II
desc: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.

name: Profanity I
desc: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume a Corpse on use, dealing more Chaos Damage if they do.

name: Profanity II
desc: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume many Corpses on use, dealing more Chaos Damage per Corpse consumed.

name: Burgeon I
desc: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.

name: Burgeon II
desc: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.

name: Steadfast I
desc: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold while Channelling them.

name: Steadfast II
desc: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold and Ailment Threshold  while Channelling them.

name: Flamepierce
desc: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Initial Projectile created by Supported Skills will always Pierce Ignited Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Ignite themselves.

name: Freezefork
desc: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Projectiles from Supported Skills always Fork when the initial Projectile Hits Frozen Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot build up Freeze themselves.

name: Stormchain
desc: Supports Projectile Skills and Skills which can Chain. Supported Skills always Chain when initially Hitting a Shocked Enemy, but cannot themselves inflict Shock. Does not support Skills which cannot Chain.

name: Verglas
desc: Supports Skills you use yourself which can Hit Enemies. Supported Skills Gain a percentage of their Damage as Cold Damage when you destroy Ice Crystals.

name: Embitter
desc: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies with Hits, causing all sources of Damage Gained to instead be treated as Damage Gained as extra Cold for Supported Skills.

name: Battershout
desc: Supports Warcry Skills. Supported Skills Consume Fully Broken Armour to trigger Physical Damage explosions on Enemies within their range but cannot themselves Break Armour.

name: Abiding Hex
desc: Supports Curse Skills you cast yourself. Supported Skills will consume Power Charges on use, gaining significant Curse duration if they do.

name: Rusted Spikes
desc: Supports Skills which deal Damage with Hits. When Supported Skills Pin an Enemy, they also Aggravate Bleeding on that Enemy.

name: Crazed Minions
desc: Supports Minion Skills which summon Reviving Minions. Supported Minions deal significantly more Damage if they have Revived Recently.

name: Spectral Volley
desc: Supports Bow or Spear Projectile Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills deal lower damage initially, but generate Spectral Projectiles, which deal more damage when they fire. Spectral Projectiles linger and will fire a short duration after no new Spectral Projectiles have been created. Cannot support Channelling Skills, Leaping skills, or skills which rain Projectiles from above.

name: Deathmarch
desc: Supports Skills which create Persistent Minions. Supported Minions will restore Life to nearby Allied Minions on death, as well as removing Ailments from those Minions.

name: Acrimony
desc: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies. Enemies affected by Damage over time from Supported Skills which was not caused by a Damaging Ailment have reduced Life regeneration rate. Only the strongest instance of this Debuff will apply. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

name: Concoct I
desc: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.

name: Concoct II
desc: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.

name: Ambrosia
desc: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana Flask charges, Gaining a percentage of damage as extra Lightning damage per Mana Flask charge consumed.

name: Ambrosia II
desc: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana Flask charges, Gaining a percentage of damage as extra Lightning damage per Mana Flask charge consumed.

name: Persistent Ground I
desc: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer.

name: Persistent Ground II
desc: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer and only end when their duration expires.

name: Persistent Ground III
desc: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer as well as lowering the Cooldown Recovery Speed of affected Enemies. Ground Surfaces from Supported Skills only end when their duration expires.

name: Selfless Remnants
desc: Supports Skills that generate Remnants, causing those Remnants to affect Allies in your Presence when collected instead of you.

name: Remnant Potency I
desc: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful.

name: Remnant Potency II
desc: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.

name: Remnant Potency III
desc: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.

name: Reverberate
desc: Supports Slam Skills. Supported Skills that have a chance to Aftershock have increased chance to cause Aftershocks the longer their Attack time.

name: Clash
desc: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills deal more Damage while you have a lower percentage of your Life remaining than the target struck, but less Damage when the reverse is true.

name: Malady
desc: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits, causing base chance to inflict Bleeding with Supported Skills to instead apply to base chance to Poison, and causing base chance to Poison to instead apply to Bleeding.

name: Syzygy
desc: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Hits from Supported Skills are considered Crushing Blows against Enemies which are both Ignited and Fully Armour Broken. Hits with Supported Skills that Heavily Stun Ignited and Fully Armour Broken Enemies will Intimidate them.

name: Overextend
desc: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills deal more Damage with Critical Hits, but Critically Hitting an Enemy with them will Daze you for a short time.

name: Retreat I
desc: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

name: Retreat II
desc: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

name: Retreat III
desc: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

name: Pursuit I
desc: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

name: Pursuit II
desc: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

name: Pursuit III
desc: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

name: Overreach
desc: Supports Attack Skills which deal Damage in an Area. Supported Skills have significantly increased Area of Effect, but are less Accurate against nearby targets.

name: Commiserate
desc: Supports Skills you use or Trigger yourself, which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills inflict more powerful Ailments if you are afflicted with those Ailments when you inflict them, while also removing from you any Ailment that they inflict.

name: Blindside
desc: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills are more likely to Critically Hit Blinded Enemies, and deal more Damage with Critical Hits against Blinded Enemies, but cannot themselves inflict Blind.

name: Hit and Run
desc: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills can only be used after you have moved a certain distance, but have massively increased Skill Speed. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown.

name: Crackling Barrier
desc: Supports Channelling Skills. While Channelling Supported Skills, you gain Lightning Thorns based off of your maximum Mana.

name: Defy I
desc: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky if you are Surrounded.

name: Defy II
desc: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky and Insufficient Mana doesn't prevent Supported Skills from being used if you are Surrounded.

name: Volatility
desc: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills grant Volatility on Critical Hit.

name: Muster
desc: Supports Skills which summon Minions. Supported Minions deal more Damage the more different kinds of Reviving Minions you have summoned.

name: Hulking Minions
desc: Supports Skills which summon Persistent Minions. Supported Minions are larger, have more Life, and deal more Damage, but cost significantly more Spirit.

name: Caltrops
tags: Attack, AoE, Projectile, Trigger, Duration, Hazard
desc: Supports Ranged Spear Attacks. Supported Skills create Caltrops when Projectiles they create reach the end of their flight.

name: Haemocrystals
desc: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Bleeding on Hit to create explosive blood-filled crystals, but cannot themselves inflict Bleeding. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Bleeding.

name: Spar
desc: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

name: Dauntless
desc: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills cannot be used unless you have been stationary for a certain duration, but deal increasingly more damage the longer you are stationary. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown or another usage Condition.

name: Magnetic Remnants
desc: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.

name: Ancestral Call I
desc: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

name: Ancestral Call II
desc: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

name: Quill Burst
desc: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills trigger Quill Burst, which deals your Thorns Damage in an Area around the target struck. Quill Burst can only be triggered on Hit after you've\nRetaliated with Thorns Damage.

name: Ancestral Aid
desc: Supports Strikes you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until you have Blocked a certain number of Hits, but will be Ancestrally Boosted when used. After use, this Blocked Hit counter will reset. Cannot Support Channelled Skills or Skills which already have a Condition for use.

name: Shocking Leap
desc: Supports Skills that leap into the air and deal damage, causing them to create Shocked Ground the first time they Critically Hit an enemy.

name: Barbs I
desc: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.

name: Barbs II
desc: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.

name: Barbs III
desc: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage twice to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.

name: Arms Length
desc: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies, causing Knockback from those Hits to be significantly more effective.

name: Charm Bounty
desc: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Charm charges.

name: Thornskin I
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Thornskin II
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Mysticism I
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Mysticism II
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Direstrike I
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Attack Damage while on Low Life while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Direstrike II
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Attack Damage while on Low Life while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Upwelling I
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Upwelling II
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Warm Blooded
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Freeze applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Cool Headed
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Ignite applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Strong Hearted
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Shock applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Untouchable
desc: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased Evasion Rating, with the increase scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

name: Refraction I
desc: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which grants Deflection Rating and causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.

name: Refraction II
desc: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which grants Deflection Rating and causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.

name: Refraction III
desc: Supports Banner Skills, causing Enemies within their area to gain Refractive Dissolution, a Debuff which lowers Elemental Resistances.

name: Cirel's Cultivation
desc: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing you from having more than one of that Totem but granting significant benefits for Supported Totems based how many allied Totems are near them. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

name: Splinter Totem I
desc: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.

name: Splinter Totem II
desc: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.

name: Punch Through
desc: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills apply Easy Target when Knocking Back Enemies, causing the next Projectile Attack Hit they take to deal increased Damage.

name: Rip
desc: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use or Trigger yourself. Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies create a Blood Remnant. Blood Remnants increase your Life regeneration rate for a short while after being collected.

name: Tear
desc: Supports Melee Attacks you use or Trigger yourself. On-Kill effects caused by Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies have a chance to occur twice.

name: Brink I
desc: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Heavy Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Heavy Stun.

name: Brink II
desc: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Stun.

name: Tireless
desc: Supports Warcry Skills. Attacks Empowered by Supported Skills have a chance not to lower the Empowerment count of Supported Skills when they are used.

name: Volcanic Eruption
tags: Attack, AoE, Melee, Strike, Projectile, Trigger, Fire
desc: Supports Melee Strike Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills trigger Volcanic Eruption on Hit against Ignited Enemies.

name: Frenzied Riposte
desc: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to Consume the Parried Debuff on Hit to grant you a Frenzy Charge. Cannot support Skills which already Consume the Parried Debuff.

name: Heightened Charges
desc: Supports any Skill that Consumes Charges, granting a chance for benefits of that Consumption to be doubled.

name: Incision
desc: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills inflict Incision on Hit, which causes Enemies to be increasingly more likely to be inflicted with Bleeding. All Incision is removed from a target on inflicting it with Bleeding.

name: Catharsis
desc: Supports any Skill you use yourself, causing supported Skill to detonate Volatility that is present on you. Supported Skill can only be used while you have a certain amount of Volatility and cannot support Skills which already have another Condition.

name: Delayed Gratification
desc: Supports Skills which require some Condition to be met for use. Supported Skills can be used an additional time after their Condition has been met, but meeting that Condition is harder.

name: Loyalty
desc: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life.

name: Romira's Requital
desc: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life. A percentage of Damage taken this way is Recouped by you as Life.

name: Rearm I
desc: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.

name: Rearm II
desc: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.

name: Delayed Reaction
desc: Supports Skills which create Hazards, causing those Hazards to only be able to trigger immediately after creation or at the end of their duration. Created Hazards have significantly lowered duration, and deal more damage.

name: Gambleshot
desc: Supports Skills which fire Projectiles that are not ground targeted. Projectiles from Supported Skills randomly Fork, Chain or Pierce.

name: Unerring Power
desc: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. When Supported Attacks are Empowered, they have significantly lowered cost and raised Accuracy.

name: Impale
desc: Supports Attacks, causing them to Impale on Hit but making them unable to Extract Impale themselves.

name: Perfection
desc: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Perfection, which is a powerful damage buff. However, failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Perfection) will remove all Perfection on you.

name: Deliberation
desc: Supports skills that can be used while moving, causing you to move slower while using them, but granting more damage in exchange.

name: Short Fuse I
desc: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, shortening the time before Detonation.

name: Short Fuse II
desc: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, massively shortening the time before Detonation at the cost of Damage.

name: Undermine
desc: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills Consume Maim on hit, Breaking a percentage of the Maimed target's Armour in doing so. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Maim.

name: Mark for Death
desc: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.

name: Mark for Death II
desc: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.

name: Admixture
desc: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Bleeding inflicted by those Hits is more effective against Poisoned Enemies, and Poison inflicted by Supported Skills is more effective against Bleeding Enemies.

name: Stoicism I
desc: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.

name: Stoicism II
desc: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.

name: Relentless Rage
desc: Supports Skills you use yourself. On spending Rage with any skill you will gain a Buff. Using Supported Skills consumes this Buff to grant you Rage.

name: Brambleslam
tags: Attack, AoE, Melee, Slam, Trigger, Physical, Hazard, Plant
desc: Supports Slam Skills. Supported Skills create Hazardous Brambles on the ground that activate after a duration. Enemies which come in contact with these thorns take damage and are Maimed. A maximum of 20 Brambles are allowed at one time. Does not modify Skills used by Minions or Totems.

name: Inhibitor
desc: Supports any Skill you use or Trigger yourself. Supported Skills cannot consume Charges or Infusion by any means. Cannot Support Skills which require Charges or Infusion to be used.

name: Static Shocks
tags: Spell, AoE, Trigger, Sustained, Lightning, Duration
desc: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Hits from Supported Skills Triggers Static Shocks, causing that enemy to become a source of Lightning damage sending pulses towards nearby enemies.

name: Hardy Totems I
desc: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.

name: Hardy Totems II
desc: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.

name: Tawhoa's Tending
desc: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life. Totems created by Supported Skills explode on death, dealing Physical damage based on their Life.

name: Encroaching Ground
desc: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those Surfaces to grow over time, up to a limit.

name: Whirlwind Lance
desc: Throw a Spear with enough force to kick up a Whirlwind where it lands, Slowing enemies and Blinding them in its area of effect. Entering the Whirlwind collapses it, dealing damage and causing Knockback. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to create the Whirlwind with one more than its normal maximum number of stages.
nText: Sandstorm swipe storm damage +% final per stage +40%

name: Primal Strikes
desc: Perform a Lightning-charged stab that can be chained into a combination of up to three attacks. The first two attacks conjure a charging Wildwood spirit if they Hit a Shocked enemy and refresh Shock duration. The third attack is a large swipe that inflicts Elemental Exposure, and can Consume Shock to conjure a stampede of spirits.

name: Cull The Weak
desc: Dash to an enemy and run them through, Culling enemies if their life is low enough. If this Attack kills at least one enemy, it grants you a Frenzy Charge, with higher Rarity monsters granting additional Charges. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.

name: Fangs of Frost
desc: Perform an icy stab that exploits enemies who are already off balance. Hitting a Parried target Consumes the Debuff to cause an explosion of frost and leave Chilled Ground.

name: Wind Serpent's Fury
desc: Consume all Frenzy Charges to perform a gigantic spear thrust that Knocks Back enemies. For each Frenzy Charge consumed, a Wind Serpent follows in the spear's wake. Each Serpent also damages and Knocks Back enemies.

name: Rake
desc: Dash towards an enemy and perform a lacerating slash, inflicting Bleeding on all enemies struck.

name: Bloodhound's Mark
tags: Attack, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Duration, Payoff
desc: Mark a target, making them suffer Heavy Stun build up from Blood Loss. The Mark will Activate, Consuming itself to Trigger Blood Explosion, when they are Heavy Stunned, or when they are killed if they suffered enough Blood Loss. The Mark's duration does not expire while the Marked target is suffering Blood Loss.
nText: Hunters mark % of phys damage over time as build up 50

name: Tame Beast
desc: Conjure Azmeri wisps to engulf a Rare Beast for a duration, Hindering them. If you defeat the Beast while it is engulfed in wisps, it will be captured by this gem, transforming the gem to instead allow you to summon the Beast as a Reviving Companion.

name: Spear of Solaris
desc: Build Glory by inflicting Freeze, Shock or Ignite on enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may call forth the Azmeri goddess Solaris, jumping backwards and throwing your Spear in the air. On landing the spear deals heavy damage in an area, then calls a divine skybeam that pulses periodically and creates expanding Ignited Ground. Modifiers to number of Projectiles fired do not apply to this skill.
nText: Chance to retain 40% of glory on use +25%

name: Storm Lance
tags: AoE, Projectile, Sustained, Lightning, Duration, Repeatable
desc: Throw an electrified Spear that lodges in the ground and periodically zaps nearby enemies with Lightning bolts. If the Spear is Detonated by another Skill, it immediately unleashes a volley of bolts and expires. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to fire bolts more frequently for a shorter duration, automatically Detonate at the end of its duration, and create Shocked Ground on Detonation.

name: Parry
desc: Ready your Buckler to parry the next Hit you would take, Blocking the Hit and retaliating with a quick sweep that leaves enemies off balance, causing them to take massively increased Attack damage for a short duration. Parrying causes you to accumulate Heavy Stun buildup. You cannot Evade a Hit you could parry, but Evasion instead grants an equal chance to avoid this Heavy Stun buildup.

name: Elemental Sundering
tags: AoE, Melee, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Nova, Payoff
desc: Plunge your Spear into the ground to emit a pulse that Consumes Freeze, Shock and Ignite on a number of nearby enemies, Allies and Corpses. The pulse itself deals no damage, but each Ailment Consumed causes an explosion of the corresponding elemental damage type.

name: Companion: {0}
desc: Summon a Reviving Beast Companion to aid you in combat.

name: Cast on Charm Use
desc: While active, gains Energy when one of your Charms is used and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.

name: Trinity
desc: Become attuned to all Elements building up Fire, Cold and Lightning Affinity based off the highest Elemental Damage type dealt by your Hits. Your Elemental Damage is enhanced the more Affinity of any type you have.
nText: Trinity skill speed +% while all resonance is at least 250 to grant +15%

name: Trail of Caltrops
tags: Buff, Persistent, AoE, Projectile, Trigger, Physical, Duration, Hazard
desc: While active, scatters caltrops in your wake when you dodge.

name: Elemental Surge
desc: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.

name: Chaotic Surge
desc: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.

name: Thundergod's Wrath
desc: While active, gains Energy when you Hit enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed Lightning spells on reaching maximum Energy.

name: Convalescence
desc: While active, grants a skill that you can use to instantly begin Recharging Energy Shield and gain a Buff for a duration that prevents that Recharge being interrupted. The Buff is removed at maximum Energy Shield and the skill cannot be used while Energy Shield is full.

name: Gemini Surge
desc: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.

name: Wing Blast
desc: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and launch yourself backwards with a powerful wingbeat that Knocks Back enemies. Enemies Primed for Heavy Stun will be stunned, release a shockwave, and have a chance to grant you a Power Charge. This skill can be used while using other skills to interrupt them.
nText: Wing blast chance to gain power charge on stun +5%

name: Bursting Fen Toad
desc: This skill creates a toad that jumps around briefly, then explodes the toad, dealing Attack damage in an area and inflicting Poison.  Damage you deal with skill is not based on your Weapon

name: Oil Barrage
tags: Shapeshift, Wyvern, AoE, Projectile, Sustained, Channelling
desc: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and spit Oil at enemies, creating Oil Ground where the Projectiles land. Consumes Power Charges if possible to instead Channel a sustained barrage of electrified Oil that does not create Oil Ground. Projectiles are fired in sequence, allowing multiple Projectiles to Hit the same target.
nText: Base oil exposure - to total elemental resistance 5

name: Iron Ward
desc: While active, stores a percentage of the Physical damage that is prevented by your Armour or other sources of damage reduction. Using this Skill releases the stored damage as a nova of spikes.

name: Flame Breath
tags: Shapeshift, Wyvern, AoE, Sustained, Fire, Duration, Channelling, Detonator
desc: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and take to the skies, immolating enemies with a jet of fire. Channelling ends after a short amount of time but can be prolonged by spending Rage. Consumes a Power Charge if possible to Empower the Skill, Gaining extra Lightning damage and spending Rage more slowly.
nText: Channelled skill suppress ongoing rage cost for first X 1000ms

name: Entangle
tags: AoE, Sustained, Physical, Duration, Repeatable, Plant
desc: Conjures a rootbound fissure that crawls forward, damaging enemies in its path. While the fissure persists, vines lash out from it and attach to nearby enemies, damaging and Slowing them.

name: Shred
tags: Shapeshift, Werewolf, AoE, Melee, Strike, Projectile, Trigger, Cold, Payoff
desc: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and lash out with a flurry of claw swipes. The first Attack can dash to faraway enemies and the final Attack Strikes twice. Attacking a Frozen enemy will create Ice Fragments, which are Projectiles that land and explode after a short delay.

name: Fury of the Mountain
tags: Shapeshift, Bear, AoE, Melee, Slam, Sustained, Duration, Channelling
desc: Shapeshift into a Bear and repeatedly pound the ground, creating Molten Fissures that travel randomly in a wide arc in front of you.
nText: Gain x rage on attack hit 2

name: Cross Slash
desc: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and leap backwards as you gouge the ground with both claws. Enemies can be Hit separately by both gouges. Hitting a Marked enemy with both gouges will Activate the Mark and cause an additional shockwave. Ice Fragments will be pulled into the location where the gouges cross and explode immediately. This skill can be used while using other skills to interrupt them.

name: Icestorm
tags: AoE, Sustained, Cold, Duration, Payoff, Repeatable, Storm
