desc: Conjure a hail of icy bolts over the targeted area. Chill and Freeze on enemies in front of you are Consumed to fuel the Icestorm by creating improved bolts.

name: Pinnacle of Power
tags: Buff, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration, Conditional
desc: Consume all Power Charges to master the elements, gaining Elemental Damage and the ability to apply Elemental Ailments with other damage types. Can only be used while you have maximum Power Charges.
nText: Elemental power elemental damage +% final per power charge +2%

name: Requiem
desc: Your weapon passively accumulates anguish from the tormented souls within. When fully charged, use this skill to compose the Requiem, transforming your Crossbow shot into a torrent of anguish for a short, fixed amount of time. Does not use Ammunition.

name: Lunar Assault
tags: Shapeshift, Werewolf, AoE, Melee, Strike, Cold
desc: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and swipe with your claws, projecting an arc of moonlight and ice forward in a crescent.
nText: Physical damage % to gain as cold 10

name: Heart of Ice
desc: Chills all enemies in your Presence.

name: Devour
desc: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and devour a Corpse or Cullable enemy, and additional nearby Corpses. For each enemy or corpse devoured, you regenerate life and gain a Power Charge. If the target is far enough away, you will leap to them and damage nearby enemies where you land. Targeting nearby enemies or corpses will not perform a leap or a Slam.
nText: Wyvern devour flask charm charge gain chance +50%

name: Thrashing Vines
desc: Spur the growth of huge vines, which emerge randomly within the target area. The vines crash to the ground then retreat, targeting nearby enemies if possible.

name: Lunar Blessing
tags: Attack, Shapeshift, Buff, Werewolf, AoE, Trigger, Cold, Duration
desc: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and offer your Rage to the moon to receive a blessing, gaining bonus Cold damage for yourself and any Wolf Minions you have from Wolf Pack or Predator's Mark. Spends all Rage to extend the Buff's duration. While the Buff is active, your Werewolf Melee Attacks call down Moonbeams on Hit.
nText: Wolf lunar blessing all damage % to gain as cold damage 10

name: Arctic Howl
tags: Shapeshift, Buff, Werewolf, AoE, Cold, Duration, Nova
desc: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and let out an icy howl that damages enemies and Freezes Primed enemies. If an enemy is Frozen or a Frozen enemy is Hit, this Skill Empowers your attacks with added Cold damage, causes Empowered Slams to create Chilled Ground, and grants your Allies added Cold damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.

name: Living Lightning
desc: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

name: Living Lightning II
desc: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

name: Frozen Spite
desc: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to create Ice Fragments on killing Frozen Enemies. Cannot Support Totem Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

name: Electromagnetism
tags: Spell, AoE, Trigger, Sustained, Lightning, Payoff
desc: Supports Skills that Hit enemies. When Supported Skills Shock an enemy that is nearby other Shocked enemies, trigger Electromagnetism, sucking in nearby enemies, Hindering them, and dealing Lightning damage at an interval.

name: Dominus' Grasp
desc: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain more times.

name: Flame Pillar
desc: Supports any Skill you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Ignite on Hit to create pillars of flame, but cannot themselves inflict Ignite. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Ignite, and does not modify the Skills of Minions.

name: Streamlined Rounds
desc: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Attack speed and bolt capacity, but deal less damage and have longer reload time.

name: Perfected Endurance
desc: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfect Timing. Supported Skills grant at least one Endurance Charge when Hitting an enemy with Perfect Timing.

name: Enduring Impact I
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.

name: Enduring Impact II
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.

name: Crater
tags: Attack, AoE, Melee, Trigger, Fire, Duration
desc: Supports Melee Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Fissures when you land. Cannot Support Totem Skills, and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

name: Vanguard I
desc: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.

name: Vanguard II
desc: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.

name: Crystalline Shards
desc: Supports Skills which create Ice Crystals. Damaging Explosions caused by Ice Crystals from Supported Skills will Impale Enemies.

name: Skittering Stone I
desc: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.

name: Skittering Stone II
desc: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.

name: Dialla's Desire
desc: Supports any Skill which has levels, increasing the level and Quality, while reducing the cost and Reservation.

name: Kalisa's Crescendo
desc: Supports Curse Skills. Enemies Cursed by Supported Skills are Pacified for the final portion of the Supported Curse's duration.

name: Durability
desc: Supports Skills which create objects that are destroyed after being Hit a number of times, allowing for them to last for additional Hits. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

name: Xoph's Pyre
desc: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Ignites.

name: Esh's Radiance
desc: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Shock.

name: Tul's Stillness
desc: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Freeze Buildup.

name: Uul-Netol's Embrace
desc: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Break Armour.

name: Rakiata's Flow
desc: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, causing those Hits to treat Enemy Elemental Resistances as inverted.

name: Rigwald's Ferocity
desc: Supports Attack skills, granting them Attack Speed at the cost of Damage or Damage at the cost of Attack Speed depending on Weapon Set they are used in. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

name: Uhtred's Exodus
desc: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them many additional levels provided no other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Uhtred's Omen
desc: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly one other support is used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Uhtred's Augury
desc: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly two other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Daresso's Passion
desc: Supports Banner Skills, causing them to require significantly less Glory to use.

name: Atziri's Allure
desc: Supports Curse Spells you cast yourself, causing those Curses to ignore the usual Curse Limit, but be reflected back to you when inflicted.

name: Atziri's Impatience
desc: Supports Skills you use yourself that have Cooldowns, dramatically increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover, but causing you to lose Life, Mana, and Energy Shield when they are used. Cannot Support Meta Skills or Persistent Skills, or modify the Skills of Minions.

name: Tacati's Ire
desc: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Poison inflicted with Supported Skills deals Damage faster the higher your Rage.

name: Zarokh's Refrain
desc: Supports Cascadable Spells you cast yourself. Supported Spells Echo thrice, but are given a Cooldown. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown.

name: Garukhan's Resolve
desc: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills have a maximum Critical Hit chance, but will Bifurcate Critical Hit Chance.

name: Kurgal's Leash
desc: Supports Commandable Minions causing you and the Supported Minion to gain Unholy Might when you Command them.

name: Kulemak's Dominion
desc: Supports Offering Skills, causing your Cascadable Spells to Cascade to the locations of Supported Offerings.

name: Amanamu's Tithe
desc: Supports Persistent Minion Skills, granting a chance when Supported Minions die for you to gain an Abyssal Monster Modifier.

name: Varashta's Blessing
desc: Supports any Skill that can deal damage, causing it to deal more damage for each different Command Skill you have used in the past few seconds. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

name: Arbiter's Ignition
desc: Supports Fire Spell Skills causing you to gain Elemental Archon when Igniting with them.

name: Arakaali's Lust
desc: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to deal increasingly higher damage the more Poisons are on the target.

name: Tasalio's Rhythm
desc: Supports Skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Tasalio's Rhythm. Tasalio's Rhythm causes Supported Skills to deal more damage and have shorter Perfect Timing windows for each stack. Failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Tasalio's Rhythm) will remove all Tasalio's Rhythm on you.

name: Xibaqua's Rending
desc: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing Corpses in the area you land to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.

name: Khatal's Rejuvenation
desc: Supports Skills that generate Remnants. Picking up Remnants from Supported Skills grants Khatal's Rejuvenation.

name: Morgana's Tempest
desc: Supports Storm skills, increasing their Limit and causing them to move quickly from the user to the target location, but become less effective. Cannot Support Triggered Skills.

name: Forge Hammer
weapon: One Hand Mace, Two Hand Mace
desc: Hurl a fiery hammer that Slams into the ground and lodges there. While the hammer is lodged in the ground, reusing this Skill recalls the hammer and resets the Skill's cooldown. Alternatively, using a Warcry near the lodged hammer causes it to shatter, releasing a number of Molten Fissures in a spiral.

name: Fulmination
desc: While active, the first time any Skill Hits a Shocked enemy in your Presence, that Skill also Hits other Shocked enemies in your Presence, up to a maximum.
nText: Wrath aura shared damage +% to other shocked enemies in presence +5%

name: Mortar Cannon
desc: Raise a cannon Ballista Totem which uses socketed Grenade Skills, with significantly improved Cooldown Recovery Rate.

name: Ancestral Cry
tags: Attack, Buff, AoE, Melee, Slam, Projectile, Trigger, Fire, Duration, Nova, Conditional
weapon: Any Melee Martial Weapon or Unarmed
desc: Perform a Warcry using Glory gained by Igniting enemies to turn you into an embodiment of Kaom. While embodying Kaom, you Trigger Volcanic Steps while travelling, Melee Strikes and Slams are Ancestrally Boosted, and your Melee Strikes Trigger Volcanic Eruption.
nText: Ancestral cry duration +% final per removable endurance charge +20%

name: Primal Bounty
desc: Empowers the next Projectile Skill you use, causing it to create additional Projectiles and fly faster.

name: Feast of Flesh
desc: Consume Corpses near you to recover Life and Mana over a short time per Corpse Consumed.
nText: Feast of flesh number of corpses 3

name: Toxic Domain
tags: Attack, AoE, Physical, Chaos, Duration, Plant
desc: Create an area of Toxic Bloom on the ground around you. While in the Bloom, you have increased Skill costs, Regenerate Life, and your Projectile Attacks attach a Toxic Pustule, which can be Poisoned. Pustules will Detonate after a duration or when enough Poison has been applied, dealing more damage based on the stored Poison damage and applying Poison in an area around it.

name: Spellslinger
desc: While active, gains Energy when you cast Spells. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.

name: Ice-Tipped Arrows
tags: Attack, Buff, AoE, Projectile, Trigger, Cold, Duration
desc: Ready your active Bow or Spear, Empowering your next Repeatable Bow or Projectile Spear Attacks to Convert Physical Damage to Cold Damage and Trigger Ice Fragments on Hit. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge. Cannot Empower Sustained Skills.

name: Crackling Palm
desc: When you Hit with Unarmed Melee Attacks, calls down lightning bolts which deal Unarmed Attack damage to all surrounding enemies.

name: Future-Past
desc: Hinekora observes your Future-Past granting you the opportunity to subvert a lesser fate. After a period of Hindsight, she will grant you her Foresight, which prevents you from avoiding Hits while Dodge Rolling. When you are Hit while Dodge Rolling, Hinekora restores you to full Life immediately before taking damage from the Hit, and grants you Sight Beyond Sight, which prevents you from dying.

name: Runic Tempering
desc: Channel to imbue your armour with Runic Plates. When you are Hit while you have these plates, some of the damage you would take will be prevented, and this skill will cause backlash, dealing your Thorns damage in an area around your attacker.

name: His Winnowing Flame
desc: Conjure an abyssal scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing Fire damage to enemies and Consuming Ignite to create pillars of flame. Cannot be Triggered.

name: His Foul Emergence
desc: Conjure a horrific skull rising from the lightless depths to bite your enemies dealing high damage at target location and leaving Withering Ground in its wake. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.

name: Siphon Elements
desc: While active, has a chance to create an Infusion Remnant when you Freeze, Shock or Ignite a target.
nText: Infusion remnants % chance to spawn cold infusion on freezing an enemy 2

name: Frost Darts
desc: Conjures a number of icy Projectiles that launch towards the target. Projectiles that Hit a Chilled or Frozen target create chunks of ice that deal additional damage on impacting the ground. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to cause each Projectile to lodge into the enemy then explode.
nText: Spell skills fire 2 additional projectiles final chance +10%

name: Abyssal Apparition
desc: Consume a Power Charge when you cast a damaging Spell to trigger an Abyssal Apparition who will also cast that same Spell for you. Does not work with Channelling Spells, Spells with a Cooldown, Triggered Spells, Spells granted by items, or Spells which already consume a Power Charge. This Skill is not directly Supportable.

name: Creeping Chill
desc: Supports any Skill that creates Ice Crystals, causing that Skill to Consume a Power Charge if possible to create Chilled Ground around the Crystal.

name: Briarpatch
tags: Spell, Persistent, AoE, Sustained, Physical, Duration, Plant
desc: While active, a portion of the Physical Attack damage you deal is stored. Casting a Spell uses the stored damage to create a patch of Thorny Ground that deals Spell damage to moving enemies.
nText: Spells chance to hinder on hit +5%

name: Eternal Rage
desc: While active, you constantly regenerate Rage.
nText: Ceaseless rage base rage regeneration per minute 30

name: Savage Fury
desc: While active, your Fury builds from Attacking enemies. Using this Skill releases your Fury to send you into a bestial frenzy, gaining damage and Onslaught but constantly losing life and forcing you into animal form. The frenzy ends immediately if you return to human form. You cannot gain Fury while in a frenzy.

name: Walking Calamity
tags: Shapeshift, Buff, Bear, AoE, Trigger, Fire, Duration, Conditional
desc: Build Glory by gaining Rage while already at maximum Rage. When you have maximum Glory, roar to the heavens to bring them down upon your enemies. For the duration of the Skill, meteors rain down around you and you Gain Fire damage and Rage regeneration. This Skill's effects are suppressed if you leave Bear form, but will resume if you return to Bear form before the duration expires.
nText: Walking calamity non skill base all damage % to gain as fire 10

name: The Stars Answer
tags: Buff, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Cold, Duration
desc: Leash the stars themselves by leveraging your vast magical power, repeatedly Triggering Starfall targeting an enemy in an area around you, or a random location in that area if no enemies can be targeted.

name: Apocalypse
tags: Spell, AoE, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration, Conditional, Storm
desc: Build Glory by Hitting enemies with Elemental damage. When you have maximum Glory, you may become the walking Apocalypse for a duration, Triggering one of multiple powerful Elemental Skills at an interval while this Buff lasts.

name: Mark of Siphoning
desc: Supports Mark Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech Mana to you when you Hit them with Attacks.

name: Mark of Siphoning II
desc: Supports Mark Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech Life and Mana to you when you Hit them with Attacks.

name: Thrill of the Kill
desc: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage for a short time.

name: Thrill of the Kill II
desc: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage and grants an increased chance to Shock for a short time.

name: Exposing Cry
desc: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills apply Exposure on Hitting enemies.

name: Opening Move
desc: Supports Travel Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against enemies on full life will Daze.

name: Accelerated Growth
desc: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown.

name: Accelerated Growth II
desc: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown, Blinding enemies Hit.

name: Fan The Flames
desc: Supports Wind Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against Ignited enemies Trigger a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them.

name: Fan The Flames II
desc: Supports Wind Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against Ignited enemies Trigger a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them. The explosion Spreads the initial enemy's Ignite to other enemies Hit.

name: Coursing Current
desc: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Supported Skills Triggers Coursing Current, which sends Chaining Lightning Projectiles to nearby Drenched enemies.

name: Mirror of Refraction
desc: Mirrors of Refraction appear in your Presence periodically. Hitting a mirror with a Spell Projectile causes it to shatter, copying the projectiles in a nova around the destroyed mirror. Copied Projectiles may be copied again when colliding with other mirrors.

name: Barkskin
desc: While active, taking Hit damage from enemies to your Energy Shield causes you to gain Armour for a short duration. Armour gained from multiple Hits can stack. The total Armour gained from this Skill cannot exceed the Item Armour on your Equipped Armour Items.
nText: Barkskin armour to gain as % of energy shield lost to enemy hits 5

name: Feral Invocation
desc: While active, gains Energy when you spend Mana. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to create visages which attack once with a socketed Shapeshifting Attack, creating multiple visages if it has enough Energy.

name: Poison Spores
tags: Attack, Buff, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Chaos, Duration, Plant
desc: Supports Plant Skills which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Trigger Toxic Pustule on Hitting an enemy.

name: Deadly Resolve
tags: Attack, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Channelling, Staged
desc: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself. While Channelling Supported Skills, periodically gain stages of Deadly Resolve. Expend a stage of Deadly Resolve when an enemy Hits you to Trigger a deadly slash towards that enemy, dealing more damage based on your Armour.

name: Advancing Storm
desc: Supports Storm skills, causing them to appear at the user's location and move towards the target location.

name: Echoing Cry
desc: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills Echo twice, and their area grows larger each time, but are less effective and require you to have travelled a certain distance before use.

name: Gorge
desc: Supports skills that consume Corpses. Consuming Corpses with supported skills grants Flask charges.

name: Empowered Sparks I
desc: Supports Skills which generate Charges. When generating Power Charge with Supported Skills, Empower some of your Attacks to Trigger Spark Projectiles on use.

name: Controlled Hazard
desc: Supports Skills which create Hazards, causing those Hazards to be unable to be triggered for 3 seconds after being created.

name: Brittle Armour
desc: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills which Freeze enemies cause Physical damage against them to Break their Armour while they remain Frozen.

name: Rending Apex
desc: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to Break Armour based on a portion of Attack damage dealt.

name: Practical Magic I
desc: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Heavy Stunning an enemy with Supported Skills increases your Spell damage for a duration.

name: Practical Magic II
desc: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Heavy Stunning an enemy with Supported Skills increases your Spell damage for a duration.

name: Blazing Critical
desc: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Critical Hits with Supported Skills imbue all of your Attacks with Fire damage for a duration.

name: Concussive Spells
desc: Supports Spells which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Daze on Critically Hitting enemies with Physical damage.

name: Eternal Mark
desc: Supports Mark Skills, causing them to not be Consumed the first time they are Activated.

name: Catalysing Elements
tags: Spell, AoE, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire
desc: Supports Skills which are boosted by Elemental Ground Surfaces, Triggering Catalysing Discharge of the corresponding type when they are boosted by an allied Elemental Ground Surface.

name: Nova Projectiles II
desc: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire extra Projectiles in a circle, at the cost of Damage and gaining a cooldown. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above. Cannot Support Skills which already have a cooldown.

name: Charged Mark
desc: Supports Mark Skills, causing them to Trigger Charged Mark when they are Activated. Charged Mark creates Shocked Ground at the target's location.

name: Minion Splash I
desc: Supports Skills which create Minions which Strike, causing those Minions' Strikes to have Melee Splash.

name: Minion Splash II
desc: Supports Skills which create Minions which Strike, increasing their Area of Effect and causing those Minions' Strikes to have Melee Splash.

name: Archon of Chayula
tags: Attack, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Chaos, Duration, Conditional, Storm
desc: Build Glory by dealing Chaos damage to enemies. When you have maximum Glory, you can entreat the Dreamer to inhabit you, briefly becoming his Archon.
nText: Archon of chayula physical and chaos damage +5%

name: Wildwood's Gifts
desc: You are chosen by Azmerian spirits who provide guidance, allowing you to see nearby Ancient Blooms.

name: Starborn Onslaught
tags: AoE, Melee, Slam, Physical, Cold, Duration
desc: Build up Glory by Freezing or Chilling enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may jump backwards loosing your Mace with the force of a falling comet onto your target. The impact releases Fissures and causes stars to fall in the area for a brief period.

name: Azmerian Swarms
tags: Minion, Persistent, Physical, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration
desc: While active, summons short-lived Azmerian Swarms when you kill enemies affected by Elemental Ailments or hit Rare or Unique enemies affected by Elemental Ailments. The swarms are untargetable Minions that pursue nearby enemies to Attack them and infict Faerie Fire on Hit.

name: Harbinger of Madness
desc: Draws out the latent fears of enemies you kill and Rare or Unique enemies you Hit, turning them into unstable apparitions which charge towards enemies and then explode.

name: Soaring Midnight
tags: AoE, Melee, Slam, Projectile, Physical, Cold, Travel
desc: Hurl your Shield as a Projectile which Returns to you at the end of its flight. While the Shield is in flight, this skill is replaced with Embrace the Fall. This skill's cooldown is skipped if you catch the Shield as it Returns, or destroy an Ice Crystal with the Embrace the Fall.
nText: Projectile base number of targets to pierce 2

name: Spirit Vessel
desc: Summons a Shapeshifting Spirit Vessel Companion that uses copies of socketed Bear, Werewolf, and Wyvern Skills.

name: Her Declaration
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing enemies that enter your Presence to become Intimidated while the Skill is active.

name: Prototype Seventeen
desc: Supports non-Channelling skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to gain Critical Hit chance based on Rage, but also remove all Rage upon Critically Hitting.

name: Seraph's Heart
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, providing a chance for enemies to calculate their Hits as though your Resistances were 90% while the skill is active.

name: Uhtred's Rite
desc: Supports skills with Cooldowns, causing them to grant Overflowing Chalice when used. Supported skills deal more damage during the effect of your Life Flask and have increased Mana Cost Efficiency during the effect of your Mana Flask.

name: Trickster's Shard
desc: Supports non-instant Spells you cast yourself. Supported Spells will Trigger Fragment Self, creating a Fractured Mimic which will cast that Spell if you get enough of them.

name: Arbiter's Reach
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you periodically grant Guard to allies in your Presence while the Skill is active.

name: Tangmazu's Thurible
desc: Supports Skills which summon Companions causing them to be Gigantic and gain Evasion and Deflection based on your own.

name: Midnight Zenith
desc: While active, Critical Hits with other skills that kill targets, or hit powerful targets cause you to gain Arctic Petals. Once you have enough Arctic Petals they will be Consumed to create Ice Crystals near the most recent target.

name: Esh's Prowess
desc: Supports Lightning skills that Hit targets, granting them an additional level and causing them to only roll the minimum or maximum value for Lightning damage. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Breachlord's Rift
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Break Armour of enemies it Freezes or Electrocutes.

name: Breachlord's Amalgam
desc: Supports Lightning or Cold skills you use yourself which fire Projectiles and do not already have cooldowns, adding a cooldown and making the Projectiles return, piercing through targets as they do so.

name: Vruun's Aftermath
desc: Supports Warcries, causing them to destroy Ice Crystals and Ice Fragments. Supported Skills empower additional Attacks if they destroy enough Ice Crystals and Ice Fragments.

name: Vruun's Inevitability
desc: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills expend their Combo when used, gaining more area of effect the higher Combo they had. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

name: Uhtred's Constellation
desc: Supports non-instant skills which have a cooldown, granting them two additional cooldown uses and more damage per different skill with a cooldown you have used recently.

name: Medved's Felling
desc: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself, causing them to attack faster the more Rage you have and grant Rage on Hit, but also making you lose Life based on your Rage when using them.

name: Vorana's Siege
desc: Supports skills which Hit targets and have an area of effect, increasing the affected area and causing it to Hit Isolated targets harder.

name: Styrn's Mountain
desc: Supports Skills that Raise your Shield causing your other melee skills to deal more damage if you block.

name: Styrn's Ferocity
desc: Supports Shield Skills that Hit enemies, causing those Hits to Crush their targets, additionally causing any Physical Damage Hits against those targets while Crushed to Break their Armour.

name: Catha's Brilliance
desc: Supports skills which create Companions, causing enemies near them to be Blinded and Ignited. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

name: Morrigan's Insight
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage and trigger Nature's Exchange when consuming Freeze on enemies. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

name: Tul's Avalanche
desc: Supports Cascadable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them when you Block, The Seals are broken when used, each making the Spell Echo. Cannot support skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

name: Virtuous Barrier
desc: While active, conjures a glittering barrier that accumulates protective gemstone Motes of each Attribute type over time, but loses a random Mote when you are Hit.
nText: Gem barrier blue grants life regeneration rate +2.5%

name: Concussive Runes
desc: Supports Attacks, causing a Runic Shockwave to erupt under enemies they Heavy Stun. The Shockwave costs Runic Ward, and will not Trigger if you do not have enough Runic Ward.

name: Leylines
desc: While active, areas of intense runic energy are revealed to you. Standing over them grants you a powerful Spell damage boost but constantly drains your Runic Ward. Running out of Runic Ward causes the energy to temporarily dissipate.

name: Frostflame Nova
desc: Unleash a wave of volatile ice that feeds on flames. While the wave doesn't deal damage, the ice latches onto Ignited enemies, refreshing the duration of their active Ignite and rapidly Freezing them but preventing them from being Ignited further until the Ignite expires.

name: Hollow Shell
desc: Sacrifice your Runic Ward to send out an energy pulse that grants nearby Allies Guard.
nText: Hollow shell spent ward % to grant as guard 5

name: Molten Shower
desc: Fires molten Projectiles from the enemy hit, which will explode when they land nearby, dealing Attack damage in an area.

name: Runic Infusion
desc: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to cost Runic Ward to use but deal additional Physical damage based on their Runic Ward cost. Cannot Support Channelling Skills, Sustained Skills, or Skills without a cost.

name: Runeforged Blades
desc: Supports Attacks you use yourself, causing them to Consume Fully Broken Armour on enemies to fire a nova of runic Projectiles at the cost of Runic Ward. The Projectiles cannot Hit the enemy from which they originated. Cannot support skills that Consume Broken Armour.

name: Powered by Verisium
desc: Spends Ward to generate Verisium Infusions, which can be used in place of any Elemental Infusions.

name: Refutation
desc: Spends all your Ward to gain a short-duration Buff that causes you to Block all Blockable Hits and apply Parried to enemies from which you've Blocked a Hit. This Buff is removed if you are Heavy Stunned. While this Buff is active, you cannot be Light Stunned, but Blocking too much damage may Heavy Stun you.

name: Repulsion
tags: Attack, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Duration, Curse, Repeatable
desc: Target an area and Curse enemies within with a Verisium Rune, inflicting them with Fragility. Hitting these enemies causes the Curse to Trigger an explosion to deal damage in an area and apply significant Knockback to other enemies near the Cursed target, with more Stun buildup based on the Fragility on the target Hit.

name: Triskelion Cascade
desc: Tap into the power of the Triskelion Flame to Empower the next Cascadable Spell you cast. The Empowered Spell becomes centred on your location, and Cascades to six areas around you in a Triskelion pattern.

name: Gelid Palm
desc: When you Hit with Unarmed Melee Attacks, projects icy wind which deal Unarmed Attack damage to all surrounding enemies and destroy Ice Crystals.

name: Skyfall
tags: Minion, AoE, Physical, Cold, Conditional, Repeatable
desc: Build Glory by spending Runic Ward. When you have maximum Glory, you may call down a mass of Verisium from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location and summoning a Temporary Minion. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. Consumes a Verisium Infusion, if possible, to increase the number of Minions summoned .

name: Detonate Living
desc: Hit an enemy under the Culling Strike Threshold, causing them to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies. Highlights enemies under the Culling Strike Threshold.
nText: Corpse explosion monster life permillage physical 20

name: Animus Exchange
desc: Sacrifice a portion of your Life to recover Runic Ward. Runic Ward recovered by this Skill can Overflow.

name: Bitter Dead
desc: Spend Ward and target an area, transforming Corpses into bitter cores that seek out enemies and Chill enemies near them. The cores explode at the end of their duration, creating runes which deal additional Cold damage over time.
nText: Volatile dead base number of corpses to consume 1

name: Eternal March
desc: Spend Runic Ward to instantly Revive your Minions. Prioritises the most powerful minions first.

name: Grim Pillars
desc: Spend Runic Ward to cause damaging Ice-Crystal spears to erupt from the ground around you. These spears can be destroyed for an explosion of Cold damage.
nText: Grim pillars number of pillars to create 2

name: Verisium Manifestations
desc: While active, Hitting with an Attack will spend Runic Ward to summon a Verisium Manifestation, a short-lived Temporary Minion that rapidly Attacks nearby enemies, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them.

name: Remnants of Kalguur
desc: While active, enemies you Stun or kill have a chance to generate a Runic Ward Remnant. These Remnants can Overflow your Runic Ward.
nText: Ward remnants chance to spawn orb on killing enemy +5%

name: Wardbound Minions
desc: Spend all your Runic Ward to summon Temporary Wardbound Casters. These Minions target nearby enemies with damaging Cold Spells.
nText: Wardbound minion maximum number of casts 2

name: Runic Extraction
desc: Supports any Skill that deals damage. Enemies you kill with supported Skills have a chance to drop a Verisium Infusion Remnant.

name: Fragments Of The Past
tags: AoE, Projectile, Trigger, Sustained, Cold, Duration
desc: Spend Runic Ward to create a Verisium volcano that deals damage on initial eruption and Triggers Ice Fragments.

name: Conductive Runes
desc: Spend Runic Ward to create a number of Hazardous Runes in a cone in front of you, which arm after a time. After arming, these Runes will activate when enemies step on them, exploding to deal Attack damage and apply Electrocution buildup.

name: Herald of the Royal Queen
tags: Attack, Persistent, AoE, Physical, Herald, Payoff
desc: Killing an enemy with Blood Loss will cause a bloody explosion that deals Physical Attack damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your Weapon Damage, but is based on their accumulated Blood Loss. The explosion destroys their Corpse if the enemy was Normal or Magic.

name: Animus Splinters
desc: Expend a large amount of Runic Ward to instantly create a short-lived copy of yourself that uses a Socketed Skill once, then vanishes. This Skill's cost is equal to the total cost of Socketed Skills. The copy cannot perform Channelled, Remote, Cooldown or Conditional Skills, or summon Minions.

name: Scouring Flame
desc: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but the skill to gain a Runic Ward cost.

name: Runic Reprieve
desc: Channel to create a protective bubble all around you, Blocking Hits against you. While Channelling this Skill, you cannot be Light Stunned by Hits you Block, and damage you take from Hits is also removed from Runic Ward. Blocking Hits this way causes you to accumulate Heavy Stun buildup. You cannot recover Runic Ward while this Skill is active.

name: Fist Of Kalguur
tags: Attack, AoE, Melee, Slam, Trigger, Physical, Duration
desc: Supports Slams you use yourself, allowing them to spend large amounts of Runic Ward to become Runically Boosted. Runically Boosted Slams are Empowered with extra Physical damage and create a rune the first time they hit an enemy. The rune erupts in an Aftershock after a duration. Cannot support Channelling Skills.

name: Voltaic Barrier
desc: Raise a pair of electrified pylons in front of you which project a wall of electricity between them, damaging and Electrocuting enemies caught between them. Projectiles you fire through the wall become energised, and discharge that energy on Hit as Chaining Lightning beams.

name: Healing Runes
desc: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to lose Runic Ward and heal nearby allies based on the Ward lost. Healing done is split between allies who are not on full Life.

name: Olroth's Conviction
desc: Supports skills that can Empower a specific number of other skills, causing them to apply to more skill uses.

name: Explosive Transmutation
tags: Spell, Persistent, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Chaos
desc: While active, picking up Remnants Triggers a deadly explosion, dealing damage at the location of the Remnant based on the type of Remnant picked up.

name: Rain of Blades
desc: Pour your Runic Ward into conjuring blades. For the duration of the Buff, these blades fall on enemies Hit by your Projectile Attacks.

name: Olroth's Hubris
desc: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to cost Runic Ward to use but deal additional Physical and Cold damage based on their Runic Ward cost, in addition to causing Physical damage to Contribute to Freeze buildup. Cannot Support Channelling Skills, Sustained Skills, or Skills without a cost.

name: Smash to Smithereens
desc: Blows strong enough to Heavy Stun an enemy reverberate in an area around the enemy and heavily Break Armour.
